title.en: Volume 8 Annals 8: Muzong, Jingzong, Wenzong, Wuzong, Xuanzong
title.raw: 卷八 本紀第八 穆宗 敬宗 文宗 武宗 宣宗 Volume 8 Annals 8: Muzong, Jingzong, Wenzong, Wuzong, Xuanzong

sentences.zh: __FORCETOC__穆宗穆宗睿聖文惠孝皇帝諱恆，憲宗第三子也。

translations.literal: __FORCETOC__Emperor Muzong, Emperor Muzong the Sagely Civil and Gracious Filial, taboo name Heng, was the third son of Xianzong.
translations.idiomatic: __FORCETOC__Emperor Muzong, posthumously honored as the Sagely Civil and Gracious Filial, bore the taboo name Heng and was the third son of Xianzong.

sentences.zh: 母曰懿安皇太后郭氏。

translations.literal: His mother was Empress Dowager Yi'an of the Guo clan.
translations.idiomatic: His mother was Empress Dowager Yi'an, née Guo.

sentences.zh: 始封建安郡王，進封遂王，遙領彰義軍節度使。

translations.literal: He was first enfeoffed as Prince of Jian'an, then advanced to Prince of Sui, and held the post of Zhangyi army military commissioner in absentia.
translations.idiomatic: He was first made Prince of Jian'an, then Prince of Sui, and served as Zhangyi military commissioner in absentia.

sentences.zh: 元和七年，惠昭太子薨，左神策軍中尉吐突承璀欲立澧王惲，而惲母賤不當立，乃立遂王為皇太子。

translations.literal: In the seventh year of Yuanhe the Brightly Filial Heir Apparent died; the Left Divine Strategy Army eunuch-commander Tufa Chenghuan wished to install Prince of Li Yun, but Yun's mother was lowly and unfit to be established, so the Prince of Sui was established as heir apparent.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh year of Yuanhe the heir apparent died; Tufa Chenghuan of the Left Divine Strategy Army sought to install Prince of Li Yun, but because Yun's mother was of humble status he could not be established, and the Prince of Sui was made heir apparent.

sentences.zh: 十五年正月庚子，憲宗崩，陳弘志殺吐突承璀及澧王。

translations.literal: In the fifteenth year, first month, day gengzi, Xianzong died; Chen Hongzhi killed Tufa Chenghuan and the Prince of Li.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifteenth year, first month, on gengzi, Xianzong died; Chen Hongzhi killed Tufa Chenghuan and the Prince of Li.

sentences.zh: 辛丑，遺詔皇太子即皇帝位于柩前，司空兼中書令韓弘攝冢宰。

translations.literal: On the day xinchou the testamentary edict had the heir apparent ascend the imperial throne before the coffin; the minister of works and concurrently director of the Secretariat Han Hong acted as overseer of the funeral rites.
translations.idiomatic: On xinchou the testamentary edict had the heir apparent take the throne before the coffin; Han Hong, minister of works and director of the Secretariat, served as acting chief mourner.

sentences.zh: 閏月丙午，皇太子即皇帝位于太極殿。

translations.literal: In the intercalary month on the day bingwu the heir apparent ascended the imperial throne at the Hall of Supreme Ultimate.
translations.idiomatic: In the intercalary month on bingwu the heir apparent took the throne at the Hall of Supreme Ultimate.

sentences.zh: 丁未，貶皇甫鎛為崖州司戶參軍。

translations.literal: On the day dingwei Huangfu Bo was demoted to registrar of Yazhou.
translations.idiomatic: On dingwei Huangfu Bo was demoted to registrar of Yazhou.

sentences.zh: 戊申，始聽政。

translations.literal: On the day wushen he began to hear government affairs.
translations.idiomatic: On wushen he began to hold court.

sentences.zh: 辛亥，御史中丞蕭俛、中書舍人翰林學士段文昌為中書侍郎、同中書門下平章事。

translations.literal: On the day xinhai the censor-in-chief Xiao Mian and the Secretariat drafting officer and Hanlin academician Duan Wenchang were made vice directors of the Secretariat and chancellors de facto of the Secretariat and Chancellery.
translations.idiomatic: On xinhai Xiao Mian, censor-in-chief, and Duan Wenchang, drafting officer of the Secretariat and Hanlin academician, were appointed vice directors of the Secretariat and chancellors de facto.

sentences.zh: 乙卯，尊母為皇太后。

translations.literal: On the day yimao his mother was honored as empress dowager.
translations.idiomatic: On yimao his mother was honored as empress dowager.

sentences.zh: 戊辰，京師地震。

translations.literal: On the day wuchen the capital earthquake.
translations.idiomatic: On wuchen the capital was shaken by an earthquake.

sentences.zh: 二月丁丑，大赦。

translations.literal: Second month, day dingchou, great amnesty.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month on dingchou a general amnesty was proclaimed.

sentences.zh: 賜文武官階、爵，高年粟帛，二王後、三恪、文宣公、嗣王、公主、縣主、武德配饗及第一等功臣家予一子官。

translations.literal: Civil and military officials were granted ranks and titles; the aged grain and silk; the two lines of Zhou and Shang kings, the three lines of former dynasties, the Duke of Literary Accomplishment, imperial collateral princes, princesses, commandery princesses, the Wu De spirit tablet sacrifices, and first-rank merit households were each granted one son an office.
translations.idiomatic: Ranks and titles were granted to civil and military officials; grain and silk to the elderly; one son of each household among the Zhou and Shang royal lines, the three former dynasties, the Duke of Literary Accomplishment, collateral princes, princesses, commandery princesses, Wu De spirit sacrifices, and first-rank merit families was granted an office.

sentences.zh: 放沒掖庭者。

translations.literal: Those confined in the inner palace were released.
translations.idiomatic: Those held in the inner palace were released.

sentences.zh: 幸丹鳳門觀俳優。

translations.literal: He visited the Crimson Phoenix Gate to watch performers.
translations.idiomatic: He visited the Crimson Phoenix Gate to watch entertainers.

sentences.zh: 丁亥，幸左神策軍觀角觝、倡戲。

translations.literal: On the day dinghai he visited the Left Divine Strategy Army to watch wrestling and song-and-dance.
translations.idiomatic: On dinghai he visited the Left Divine Strategy Army to watch wrestling and variety performances.

sentences.zh: 乙未，吐蕃寇靈州。

translations.literal: On the day yiwei the Tibetans raided Lingzhou.
translations.idiomatic: On yiwei Tibet raided Lingzhou.

sentences.zh: 丙申，丹王逾薨。

translations.literal: On the day bingshen Prince of Dan Yu died.
translations.idiomatic: On bingshen Prince of Dan Yu died.

sentences.zh: 三月乙巳，杜叔良及吐蕃戰，敗之。

translations.literal: Third month, day yisi, Du Shuliang fought the Tibetans and defeated them.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month on yisi Du Shuliang fought Tibet and defeated them.

sentences.zh: 戊辰，大風，雨雹。

translations.literal: On the day wuchen great wind; hail.
translations.idiomatic: On wuchen a great wind blew and hail fell.

sentences.zh: 辛未，楊清伏誅。

translations.literal: On the day xinwei Yang Qing was executed.
translations.idiomatic: On xinwei Yang Qing was executed.

sentences.zh: 五月庚申，葬聖神章武孝皇帝于景陵。

translations.literal: Fifth month, day gengshen, the Sagely Divine Martial and Filial Emperor was buried at Jing Mausoleum.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month on gengshen the Sagely Divine Martial and Filial Emperor was buried at Jing Mausoleum.

sentences.zh: 六月丁丑，韓弘罷。

translations.literal: Sixth month, day dingchou, Han Hong was dismissed.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month on dingchou Han Hong was dismissed.

sentences.zh: 七月丁卯，令狐楚罷。

translations.literal: Seventh month, day dingmao, Linghu Chu was dismissed.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month on dingmao Linghu Chu was dismissed.

sentences.zh: 八月乙酉，容管經略留後嚴公素及黃洞蠻戰于神步，敗之。

translations.literal: Eighth month, day yiyou, the Rongguan pacification commissioner acting rear-guard Yan Gusù fought the Yellow Cave barbarians at Shenbu and defeated them.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month on yiyou Yan Gusù, acting rear-guard of the Rongguan pacification commission, fought the Yellow Cave tribes at Shenbu and defeated them.

sentences.zh: 戊戌，御史中丞崔植為中書侍郎、同中書門下平章事。

translations.literal: On the day wuxu the censor-in-chief Cui Zhi was made vice director of the Secretariat and chancellor de facto.
translations.idiomatic: On wuxu Cui Zhi, censor-in-chief, was appointed vice director of the Secretariat and chancellor de facto.

sentences.zh: 九月辛丑，觀競渡、角觝于魚藻宮，用樂。

translations.literal: Ninth month, day xinchou, he watched boat-racing and wrestling at the Fish-and-Water Palace, with music.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month on xinchou he watched boat races and wrestling at the Fish-and-Water Palace, with music.

sentences.zh: 十月庚辰，王承宗卒。

translations.literal: Tenth month, day gengchen, Wang Chengzong died.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month on gengchen Wang Chengzong died.

sentences.zh: 辛巳，成德軍觀察支使王承元以鎮、趙、深、冀四州歸于有司。

translations.literal: On the day xinsi the Chengde army observation staff officer Wang Chengyuan submitted the four prefectures Zhen, Zhao, Shen, and Ji to the central authorities.
translations.idiomatic: On xinsi Wang Chengyuan, staff officer of the Chengde observation commission, submitted Zhen, Zhao, Shen, and Ji to the central government.

sentences.zh: 癸未，吐蕃寇涇州，右神策軍中尉梁守謙為左右神策、京西、京北行營都監以禦之。

translations.literal: On the day guimao the Tibetans raided Jingzhou; the Right Divine Strategy Army eunuch-commander Liang Shouqian was made overall supervisor of the Left and Right Divine Strategy armies and the Jingxi and Jingbei campaign forces to resist them.
translations.idiomatic: On guimao Tibet raided Jingzhou; Liang Shouqian, eunuch-commander of the Right Divine Strategy Army, was made overall supervisor of the Left and Right Divine Strategy armies and the Jingxi and Jingbei campaign forces to resist them.

sentences.zh: 丙戌，吐蕃遁。

translations.literal: On the day bingxu the Tibetans withdrew.
translations.idiomatic: On bingxu Tibet withdrew.

sentences.zh: 十一月癸卯，赦鎮、趙、深、冀四州死罪以下，賜成德軍將士錢。

translations.literal: Eleventh month, day guimao, those guilty of capital crimes and below in the four prefectures Zhen, Zhao, Shen, and Ji were pardoned; the Chengde army soldiers were granted money.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month on guimao capital crimes and below in Zhen, Zhao, Shen, and Ji were pardoned; Chengde troops were granted money.

sentences.zh: 十二月庚辰，獵于城南。

translations.literal: Twelfth month, day gengchen, he hunted south of the city.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month on gengchen he hunted south of the capital.

sentences.zh: 壬午，擊鞠于右神策軍，遂獵于城西。

translations.literal: On the day renwu he played cuju at the Right Divine Strategy Army, then hunted west of the city.
translations.idiomatic: On renwu he played cuju at the Right Divine Strategy Army, then hunted west of the capital.

sentences.zh: 甲申，獵于苑北。

translations.literal: On the day jiashen he hunted north of the park.
translations.idiomatic: On jiashen he hunted north of the imperial park.

sentences.zh: 長慶元年正月己亥，朝獻于太清宮。

translations.literal: First year of Changqing, first month, day jihai, he offered tribute at the Grand Pure Palace.
translations.idiomatic: In the first year of Changqing, first month, on jihai he offered tribute at the Grand Pure Palace.

sentences.zh: 庚子，朝享于太廟。

translations.literal: On the day gengzi he offered sacrifice at the Imperial Ancestral Temple.
translations.idiomatic: On gengzi he sacrificed at the Imperial Ancestral Temple.

sentences.zh: 辛丑，有事于南郊。

translations.literal: On the day xinchou he performed the suburban sacrifice.
translations.idiomatic: On xinchou he performed the suburban sacrifice.

sentences.zh: 大赦，改元，賜文武官階、勳、爵。

translations.literal: Great amnesty; the reign title was changed; civil and military officials were granted ranks and merit titles.
translations.idiomatic: A general amnesty was proclaimed, the reign title was changed, and ranks and merit titles were granted to civil and military officials.

sentences.zh: 己未，有星孛于翼。

translations.literal: On the day jiwei a comet appeared in Wings.
translations.idiomatic: On jiwei a comet appeared in the Wings asterism.

sentences.zh: 壬戌，蕭俛罷。

translations.literal: On the day renxu Xiao Mian was dismissed.
translations.idiomatic: On renxu Xiao Mian was dismissed.

sentences.zh: 丁卯，有星孛于太微。

translations.literal: On the day dingmao a comet appeared in Supreme Palace Enclosure.
translations.idiomatic: On dingmao a comet appeared in the Supreme Palace Enclosure.

sentences.zh: 二月乙亥，觀樂于麟德殿。

translations.literal: Second month, day yihai, he watched music at the Hall of Virtue and Felicity.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month on yihai he watched music at the Hall of Virtue and Felicity.

sentences.zh: 丙子，觀神策諸軍雜伎。

translations.literal: On the day bingzi he watched the miscellaneous performances of the Divine Strategy armies.
translations.idiomatic: On bingzi he watched variety performances of the Divine Strategy armies.

sentences.zh: 己卯，劉緫以盧龍軍八州歸于有司。

translations.literal: On the day jimao Liu Zong submitted the eight prefectures of the Lulong army to the central authorities.
translations.idiomatic: On jimao Liu Zong submitted the eight Lulong prefectures to the central government.

sentences.zh: 壬午，段文昌罷。

translations.literal: On the day renwu Duan Wenchang was dismissed.
translations.idiomatic: On renwu Duan Wenchang was dismissed.

sentences.zh: 翰林學士、戶部侍郎杜元穎同中書門下平章事。

translations.literal: The Hanlin academician and vice minister of revenue Du Yuanying was made chancellor de facto.
translations.idiomatic: Du Yuanying, Hanlin academician and vice minister of revenue, was appointed chancellor de facto.

sentences.zh: 辛卯，擊鞠于麟德殿。

translations.literal: On the day xinmao he played cuju at the Hall of Virtue and Felicity.
translations.idiomatic: On xinmao he played cuju at the Hall of Virtue and Felicity.

sentences.zh: 三月庚戌，太白晝見。

translations.literal: Third month, day gengxu, Venus was seen in daylight.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month on gengxu Venus was visible in daylight.

sentences.zh: 丁巳，赦幽、涿、檀、順、瀛、莫、營、平八州死罪以下，給復一年。

translations.literal: On the day dingsi those guilty of capital crimes and below in the eight prefectures You, Zhuo, Tan, Shun, Ying, Mo, Ying, and Ping were pardoned; tax remission for one year.
translations.idiomatic: On dingsi capital crimes and below in You, Zhuo, Tan, Shun, Ying, Mo, Ying, and Ping were pardoned and taxes remitted for one year.

sentences.zh: 賜盧龍軍士錢。

translations.literal: The Lulong army soldiers were granted money.
translations.idiomatic: Lulong troops were granted money.

sentences.zh: 戊午，封弟憬為鄜王，悅瓊王，恂沔王，懌婺王，愔茂王，怡光王，恊淄王，憺衢王，㤝澶王；

translations.literal: On the day wuwu his younger brothers were enfeoffed: Jing as Prince of Bin, Yue as Prince of Qiong, Xun as Prince of Mian, Yi as Prince of Wu, Yin as Prince of Mao, Yi as Prince of Guang, Xie as Prince of Zi, Dan as Prince of Qu, and Cong as Prince of Chan;
translations.idiomatic: On wuwu his younger brothers were enfeoffed: Jing as Prince of Bin, Yue as Prince of Qiong, Xun as Prince of Mian, Yi as Prince of Wu, Yin as Prince of Mao, Yi as Prince of Guang, Xie as Prince of Zi, Dan as Prince of Qu, and Cong as Prince of Chan;

sentences.zh: 子湛為鄂王，涵江王，湊漳王，溶安王，瀍潁王。

translations.literal: his sons Zhan as Prince of E, Han as Prince of Jiang, Cou as Prince of Zhang, Rong as Prince of An, and Chan as Prince of Ying.
translations.idiomatic: his sons Zhan as Prince of E, Han as Prince of Jiang, Cou as Prince of Zhang, Rong as Prince of An, and Chan as Prince of Ying.

sentences.zh: 是月。

translations.literal: In that month.
translations.idiomatic: In that month.

sentences.zh: 徙封湛為景王。

translations.literal: Prince of E Zhan was transferred and enfeoffed as Prince of Jing.
translations.idiomatic: Zhan, Prince of E, was transferred to Prince of Jing.

sentences.zh: 五月丙辰，建王審薨。

translations.literal: Fifth month, day bingchen, Prince of Jian Shen died.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month on bingchen Prince of Jian Shen died.

sentences.zh: 六月，有彗星出于昴。

translations.literal: Sixth month: a comet appeared in the Hairy Head.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month a comet appeared in the Hairy Head asterism.

sentences.zh: 辛未，吐蕃寇青塞烽，鹽州刺史李文悅敗之。

translations.literal: On the day xinwei the Tibetans raided the Green Frontier Beacon; the Yanzhou prefect Li Wenyue defeated them.
translations.idiomatic: On xinwei Tibet raided the Green Frontier Beacon; Li Wenyue, prefect of Yan, defeated them.

sentences.zh: 七月甲辰，幽州盧龍軍都知兵馬使朱克融囚其節度使張弘靖以反。

translations.literal: Seventh month, day jiachen, the Youzhou Lulong army overall horse-and-army envoy Zhu Keyong imprisoned his military commissioner Zhang Hongjing and rebelled.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month on jiachen Zhu Keyong, overall horse-and-army envoy of Youzhou Lulong, imprisoned his commissioner Zhang Hongjing and rebelled.

sentences.zh: 壬子，羣臣上尊號曰文武孝德皇帝。

translations.literal: On the day renzi the ministers offered the honorific title Civil and Martial Filial and Virtuous Emperor.
translations.idiomatic: On renzi the ministers offered the honorific Civil and Martial Filial and Virtuous Emperor.

sentences.zh: 大赦，賜文武官階、勳、爵。

translations.literal: Great amnesty; civil and military officials were granted ranks and merit titles.
translations.idiomatic: A general amnesty was proclaimed and ranks and merit titles granted to civil and military officials.

sentences.zh: 壬戌，成德軍大將王廷湊殺其節度使田弘正以反。

translations.literal: On the day renxu the Chengde army great general Wang Tingcou killed his military commissioner Tian Hongzheng and rebelled.
translations.idiomatic: On renxu Wang Tingcou, a great general of Chengde, killed his commissioner Tian Hongzheng and rebelled.

sentences.zh: 八月壬申，朱克融陷莫州。

translations.literal: Eighth month, day renshen, Zhu Keyong captured Mozhou.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month on renshen Zhu Keyong captured Mo prefecture.

sentences.zh: 癸酉，王廷湊陷冀州，刺史王進岌死之。

translations.literal: On the day guiyou Wang Tingcou captured Jizhou; the prefect Wang Jinji died.
translations.idiomatic: On guiyou Wang Tingcou captured Ji prefecture; Prefect Wang Jinji was killed.

sentences.zh: 丙子，瀛州軍亂，執其觀察使盧士玫，叛附于朱克融。

translations.literal: On the day bingzi the Yingzhou army mutinied, seized its observation commissioner Lu Shimei, and rebelled to join Zhu Keyong.
translations.idiomatic: On bingzi the Yingzhou garrison mutinied, seized Observation Commissioner Lu Shimei, and joined Zhu Keyong in rebellion.

sentences.zh: 王廷湊寇深州。

translations.literal: Wang Tingcou raided Shenzhou.
translations.idiomatic: Wang Tingcou raided Shen prefecture.

sentences.zh: 丁丑，魏博、橫海、昭義、河東、義武兵討王廷湊。

translations.literal: On the day dingchou the Weibo, Henghai, Zhaoyi, Hedong, and Yiwu armies campaigned against Wang Tingcou.
translations.idiomatic: On dingchou the armies of Weibo, Henghai, Zhaoyi, Hedong, and Yiwu marched against Wang Tingcou.

sentences.zh: 己丑，裴度為幽、鎮招撫使。

translations.literal: On the day jichou Pei Du was made pacification commissioner for You and Zhen.
translations.idiomatic: On jichou Pei Du was appointed pacification commissioner for You and Zhen.

sentences.zh: 九月乙巳，相州軍亂，殺其刺史邢濋。

translations.literal: Ninth month, day yisi, the Xiangzhou army mutinied and killed its prefect Xing Ji.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month on yisi the Xiangzhou garrison mutinied and killed Prefect Xing Ji.

sentences.zh: 十月丙寅，諸道鹽鐵轉運使、刑部尚書王播為中書侍郎、同中書門下平章事。

translations.literal: Tenth month, day bingyin, the salt and iron transport commissioner and minister of justice Wang Bo was made vice director of the Secretariat and chancellor de facto.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month on bingyin Wang Bo, salt and iron transport commissioner and minister of justice, was appointed vice director of the Secretariat and chancellor de facto.

sentences.zh: 裴度為鎮州西面行營都招討使。

translations.literal: Pei Du was made overall campaign commander on the western front of Zhenzhou.
translations.idiomatic: Pei Du was made overall campaign commander on the western Zhen front.

sentences.zh: 左領軍衞大將軍杜叔良為深州諸道行營節度使。

translations.literal: The Left Army Guard great general Du Shuliang was made military commissioner of the Shenzhou multi-circuit campaign.
translations.idiomatic: Du Shuliang, great general of the Left Army Guard, was made military commissioner of the Shenzhou multi-circuit campaign.

sentences.zh: 戊寅，王廷湊陷貝州。

translations.literal: On the day wuyin Wang Tingcou captured Beizhou.
translations.idiomatic: On wuyin Wang Tingcou captured Bei prefecture.

sentences.zh: 己卯，易州刺史柳公濟及朱克融戰于白石，敗之。

translations.literal: On the day jimao the Yizhou prefect Liu Gongji fought Zhu Keyong at White Stone and defeated him.
translations.idiomatic: On jimao Liu Gongji, prefect of Yi, fought Zhu Keyong at White Stone and defeated him.

sentences.zh: 庚辰，橫海軍節度使烏重胤及王廷湊戰于饒陽，敗之。

translations.literal: On the day gengchen the Henghai military commissioner Wu Zhongyin fought Wang Tingcou at Raoyang and defeated him.
translations.idiomatic: On gengchen Wu Zhongyin of Henghai fought Wang Tingcou at Raoyang and defeated him.

sentences.zh: 辛卯，靈武節度使李進誠及吐蕃戰于大石山，敗之。

translations.literal: On the day xinmao the Lingwu military commissioner Li Jincheng fought the Tibetans at Great Stone Mountain and defeated them.
translations.idiomatic: On xinmao Li Jincheng of Lingwu fought Tibet at Great Stone Mountain and defeated them.

sentences.zh: 十一月甲午，裴度及王廷湊戰于會星，敗之。

translations.literal: Eleventh month, day jiawu, Pei Du fought Wang Tingcou at Meeting Star and defeated him.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month on jiawu Pei Du fought Wang Tingcou at Meeting Star and defeated him.

sentences.zh: 丙申，朱克融寇定州，義武軍節度使陳楚敗之。

translations.literal: On the day bingshen Zhu Keyong raided Dingzhou; the Yiwu military commissioner Chen Chu defeated him.
translations.idiomatic: On bingshen Zhu Keyong raided Ding prefecture; Chen Chu of Yiwu defeated him.

sentences.zh: 十二月庚午，杜叔良及王廷湊戰于博野，敗績。

translations.literal: Twelfth month, day gengwu, Du Shuliang fought Wang Tingcou at Boye and was defeated.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month on gengwu Du Shuliang fought Wang Tingcou at Boye and was defeated.

sentences.zh: 丁丑，陳楚及朱克融戰于望都，敗之。

translations.literal: On the day dingchou Chen Chu fought Zhu Keyong at Wangdu and defeated him.
translations.idiomatic: On dingchou Chen Chu fought Zhu Keyong at Wangdu and defeated him.

sentences.zh: 乙酉，赦朱克融。

translations.literal: On the day yiyou Zhu Keyong was pardoned.
translations.idiomatic: On yiyou Zhu Keyong was pardoned.

sentences.zh: 己丑，陳楚及克融戰于清源，敗之。

translations.literal: On the day jichou Chen Chu fought Keyong at Qingyuan and defeated him.
translations.idiomatic: On jichou Chen Chu fought Keyong at Qingyuan and defeated him.

sentences.zh: 二年正月庚子，魏博軍潰于南宮。

translations.literal: Second year, first month, day gengzi, the Weibo army was routed at Nangong.
translations.idiomatic: In the second year, first month, on gengzi the Weibo army was routed at Nangong.

sentences.zh: 癸卯，魏博節度使田布自殺，兵馬使史憲誠自稱留後。

translations.literal: On the day guimao the Weibo military commissioner Tian Bu committed suicide; the horse-and-army envoy Shi Xiancheng styled himself acting commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: On guimao Tian Bu of Weibo committed suicide; Shi Xiancheng, horse-and-army envoy, declared himself acting commissioner.

sentences.zh: 海州海冰。

translations.literal: Haizhou sea ice.
translations.idiomatic: The sea at Haizhou froze.

sentences.zh: 二月甲子，赦王廷湊。

translations.literal: Second month, day jiazi, Wang Tingcou was pardoned.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month on jiazi Wang Tingcou was pardoned.

sentences.zh: 辛巳，崔植罷。

translations.literal: On the day xinsi Cui Zhi was dismissed.
translations.idiomatic: On xinsi Cui Zhi was dismissed.

sentences.zh: 工部侍郎元稹同中書門下平章事。

translations.literal: The vice minister of works Yuan Zhen was made chancellor de facto.
translations.idiomatic: Yuan Zhen, vice minister of works, was appointed chancellor de facto.

sentences.zh: 戊子，昭義軍節度使劉悟囚其監軍使劉承偕。

translations.literal: On the day wuzi the Zhaoyi military commissioner Liu Wu imprisoned his army supervisory commissioner Liu Chengxie.
translations.idiomatic: On wuzi Liu Wu of Zhaoyi imprisoned his army supervisory commissioner Liu Chengxie.

sentences.zh: 三月乙巳，武寧軍節度副使王智興逐其節度使崔羣。

translations.literal: Third month, day yisi, the Wuning army deputy commissioner Wang Zhixing expelled its military commissioner Cui Qun.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month on yisi Wang Zhixing, deputy commissioner of Wuning, expelled Commissioner Cui Qun.

sentences.zh: 戊午，守司徒、淮南節度使裴度同中書門下平章事。

translations.literal: On the day wuwu the acting grand mentor and Huainan military commissioner Pei Du was made chancellor de facto.
translations.idiomatic: On wuwu Pei Du, acting grand mentor and Huainan commissioner, was appointed chancellor de facto.

sentences.zh: 王播罷。

translations.literal: Wang Bo was dismissed.
translations.idiomatic: Wang Bo was dismissed.

sentences.zh: 四月辛酉朔，日有食之。

translations.literal: Fourth month, first day xinyou, there was an eclipse of the sun.
translations.idiomatic: On the first day of the fourth month, xinyou, there was a solar eclipse.

sentences.zh: 壬戌，成德軍節度使牛元翼奔于京師，王廷湊陷深州。

translations.literal: On the day renxu the Chengde military commissioner Niu Yuanyi fled to the capital; Wang Tingcou captured Shenzhou.
translations.idiomatic: On renxu Niu Yuanyi of Chengde fled to the capital; Wang Tingcou captured Shen prefecture.

sentences.zh: 五月壬寅，邕州刺史李元宗叛，奔于黃洞蠻。

translations.literal: Fifth month, day renyin, the Yongzhou prefect Li Yuanzong rebelled and fled to the Yellow Cave barbarians.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month on renyin Prefect Li Yuanzong of Yong rebelled and fled to the Yellow Cave tribes.

sentences.zh: 六月癸亥，宣武軍宿直將李臣則逐其節度使李愿，衙門都將李㝏反。

translations.literal: Sixth month, day guihai, the Xuanwu army night-duty officer Li Chenze expelled its military commissioner Li Yuan; the yamen gate overall officer Li Yin rebelled.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month on guihai Li Chenze, night-duty officer of Xuanwu, expelled Commissioner Li Yuan; Li Yin, overall officer of the yamen gate, rebelled.

sentences.zh: 甲子，裴度、元稹罷。

translations.literal: On the day jiazi Pei Du and Yuan Zhen were dismissed.
translations.idiomatic: On jiazi Pei Du and Yuan Zhen were dismissed.

sentences.zh: 兵部尚書李逢吉為門下侍郎、同中書門下平章事。

translations.literal: The minister of war Li Fengji was made vice director of the Chancellery and chancellor de facto.
translations.idiomatic: Li Fengji, minister of war, was appointed vice director of the Chancellery and chancellor de facto.

sentences.zh: 乙丑，大風落太廟鴟尾。

translations.literal: On the day yichou great wind knocked down the Imperial Temple ridge ornaments.
translations.idiomatic: On yichou a great wind knocked down the ridge ornaments of the Imperial Temple.

sentences.zh: 癸酉，吐蕃寇靈州，鹽州刺史趙旰敗之。

translations.literal: On the day guiyou the Tibetans raided Lingzhou; the Yanzhou prefect Zhao Gan defeated them.
translations.idiomatic: On guiyou Tibet raided Lingzhou; Zhao Gan, prefect of Yan, defeated them.

sentences.zh: 七月丙申，宋王結薨。

translations.literal: Seventh month, day bingshen, Prince of Song Jie died.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month on bingshen Prince of Song Jie died.

sentences.zh: 戊申，李㝏陷宋州。

translations.literal: On the day wushen Li Yin captured Songzhou.
translations.idiomatic: On wushen Li Yin captured Song prefecture.

sentences.zh: 丙辰，兗鄆節度使曹華及李㝏戰于宋州，敗之。

translations.literal: On the day bingchen the Yan-Yun military commissioner Cao Hua fought Li Yin at Songzhou and defeated him.
translations.idiomatic: On bingchen Cao Hua of Yan-Yun fought Li Yin at Song prefecture and defeated him.

sentences.zh: 丁巳，忠武軍節度使李光顏又敗之于尉氏。

translations.literal: On the day dingsi the Zhongwu military commissioner Li Guangyan again defeated him at Weishi.
translations.idiomatic: On dingsi Li Guangyan of Zhongwu again defeated him at Weishi.

sentences.zh: 八月壬申，宣武軍節度使韓充又敗之于郭橋。

translations.literal: Eighth month, day renshen, the Xuanwu military commissioner Han Chong again defeated him at Guoqiao.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month on renshen Han Chong of Xuanwu again defeated him at Guoqiao.

sentences.zh: 丙子，李㝏伏誅。

translations.literal: On the day bingzi Li Yin was executed.
translations.idiomatic: On bingzi Li Yin was executed.

sentences.zh: 癸未，詔瘞汴、宋、鄭三州戰亡者，稟其家三歲。

translations.literal: On the day guimao an edict ordered burial of those who died in battle in Bian, Song, and Zheng prefectures; their households were granted provisions for three years.
translations.idiomatic: On guimao an edict ordered the burial of war dead from Bian, Song, and Zheng and granted their households three years' provisions.

sentences.zh: 九月戊子，鎮海軍將王國清謀反，伏誅。

translations.literal: Ninth month, day wuzi, the Zhenhai army officer Wang Guoqing plotted rebellion and was executed.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month on wuzi Wang Guoqing of Zhenhai plotted rebellion and was executed.

sentences.zh: 丙申，德州軍亂，殺其刺史王稷。

translations.literal: On the day bingshen the Dezhou army mutinied and killed its prefect Wang Ji.
translations.idiomatic: On bingshen the Dezhou garrison mutinied and killed Prefect Wang Ji.

sentences.zh: 十月己卯，獵于咸陽。

translations.literal: Tenth month, day jimao, he hunted at Xianyang.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month on jimao he hunted at Xianyang.

sentences.zh: 十一月庚午，皇太后幸華清宮。

translations.literal: Eleventh month, day gengwu, the empress dowager visited the Huaqing Palace.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month on gengwu the empress dowager visited Huaqing Palace.

sentences.zh: 癸酉，迎皇太后，遂獵于驪山。

translations.literal: On the day guiyou the empress dowager was welcomed; he then hunted at Mount Li.
translations.idiomatic: On guiyou the empress dowager was welcomed back, and he then hunted at Mount Li.

sentences.zh: 丙子，集王緗薨。

translations.literal: On the day bingzi Prince of Ji Xiang died.
translations.idiomatic: On bingzi Prince of Ji Xiang died.

sentences.zh: 十二月丁亥，不豫，放五坊鷹隼及供獵狐兔。

translations.literal: Twelfth month, day dinghai, he was unwell; hawks and falcons of the Five Paddocks and hunting foxes and rabbits were released.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month on dinghai he fell ill; hawks and falcons of the Five Paddocks and hunting animals were released.

sentences.zh: 癸巳，立景王湛為皇太子。

translations.literal: On the day guisi Prince of Jing Zhan was established as heir apparent.
translations.idiomatic: On guisi Prince of Jing Zhan was made heir apparent.

sentences.zh: 癸丑，降死罪以下，賜文武常參及州府長官子為父後者勳兩轉，宗子諸親一轉。

translations.literal: On the day guichou capital crimes and below were reduced; civil and military regular attendees and prefectural commissioners' sons who succeeded their fathers were granted two merit turns, collateral kin one turn.
translations.idiomatic: On guichou capital crimes and below were pardoned; sons who succeeded their fathers among regular officials and prefectural commissioners received two merit turns, and collateral kin one turn.

sentences.zh: 是冬，無冰，草木萌。

translations.literal: That winter there was no ice; plants sprouted.
translations.idiomatic: That winter there was no ice and plants sprouted anew.

sentences.zh: 三年三月壬戌，御史中丞牛僧孺為戶部侍郎、同中書門下平章事。

translations.literal: Third year, third month, day renxu, the censor-in-chief Niu Sengru was made vice minister of revenue and chancellor de facto.
translations.idiomatic: In the third year, third month, on renxu Niu Sengru, censor-in-chief, was appointed vice minister of revenue and chancellor de facto.

sentences.zh: 癸亥，淮南、浙東西、江南、宣歙旱，遣使宣撫，理繫囚，察官吏。

translations.literal: On the day guihai Huainan, the two Zhedong circuits, Jiangnan, and Xuanshe suffered drought; envoys were sent to comfort and pacify, handle prisoners, and inspect officials.
translations.idiomatic: On guihai Huainan, the two Zhedong circuits, Jiangnan, and Xuanshe suffered drought; envoys were sent to comfort the people, review prisoners, and inspect officials.

sentences.zh: 四月甲午，陸州獠反。

translations.literal: Fourth month, day jiawu, the Lu prefecture Liao rebelled.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month on jiawu the Liao of Lu prefecture rebelled.

sentences.zh: 五月壬申，京師雨雹。

translations.literal: Fifth month, day renshen, the capital rained hail.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month on renshen hail fell in the capital.

sentences.zh: 七月丙寅，黃洞蠻陷欽州。

translations.literal: Seventh month, day bingyin, the Yellow Cave barbarians captured Qinzhou.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month on bingyin the Yellow Cave tribes captured Qin prefecture.

sentences.zh: 九月壬子朔，日有食之。

translations.literal: Ninth month, first day renzi, there was an eclipse of the sun.
translations.idiomatic: On the first day of the ninth month, renzi, there was a solar eclipse.

sentences.zh: 十月己丑，杜元穎罷。

translations.literal: Tenth month, day jichou, Du Yuanying was dismissed.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month on jichou Du Yuanying was dismissed.

sentences.zh: 辛卯，黃洞蠻寇安南。

translations.literal: On the day xinmao the Yellow Cave barbarians raided Annan.
translations.idiomatic: On xinmao the Yellow Cave tribes raided Annan.

sentences.zh: 四年正月辛亥，降死罪以下，減流人一歲。

translations.literal: Fourth year, first month, day xinhai, capital crimes and below were reduced; exiles' sentences were reduced one year.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth year, first month, on xinhai capital crimes and below were pardoned and exiles' sentences reduced by one year.

sentences.zh: 賜文武官及宗子、賀正使階、勳、爵。

translations.literal: Civil and military officials and collateral princes and New Year's envoys were granted ranks, merit titles, and titles.
translations.idiomatic: Ranks, merit titles, and titles were granted to civil and military officials, collateral princes, and New Year's envoys.

sentences.zh: 詔百官言事。

translations.literal: An edict ordered all officials to submit memorials.
translations.idiomatic: An edict invited memorials from all officials.

sentences.zh: 辛未，以皇太子權句當軍國政事。

translations.literal: On the day xinwei the heir apparent was authorized to handle military and state affairs.
translations.idiomatic: On xinwei the heir apparent was authorized to handle state and military affairs.

sentences.zh: 壬申，皇帝崩于清思殿，年三十。

translations.literal: On the day renshen the emperor died at the Hall of Pure Thought, aged thirty.
translations.idiomatic: On renshen the emperor died in the Hall of Pure Thought, aged thirty.

sentences.zh: 敬宗敬宗睿武昭愍孝皇帝諱湛，穆宗長子也。

translations.literal: __FORCETOC__Emperor Jingzong, Emperor Jingzong the Sagely Martial and Lamenting Filial, taboo name Zhan, was the eldest son of Muzong.
translations.idiomatic: __FORCETOC__Emperor Jingzong, posthumously honored as the Sagely Martial and Lamenting Filial, bore the taboo name Zhan and was the eldest son of Muzong.

sentences.zh: 母曰恭僖皇太后王氏。

translations.literal: His mother was Empress Dowager Gongxi of the Wang clan.
translations.idiomatic: His mother was Empress Dowager Gongxi, née Wang.

sentences.zh: 始封鄂王，徙封景王。

translations.literal: He was first enfeoffed as Prince of E, then transferred and enfeoffed as Prince of Jing.
translations.idiomatic: He was first Prince of E, then transferred to Prince of Jing.

sentences.zh: 長慶二年十二月，穆宗因擊毬暴得疾，不見羣臣者三日。

translations.literal: Twelfth month of the second year of Changqing, Muzong suddenly fell ill from playing cuju and did not see the ministers for three days.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month of the second year of Changqing Muzong fell suddenly ill from cuju and did not receive ministers for three days.

sentences.zh: 左僕射裴度三上疏，請立皇太子，而翰林學士、兩省官相次皆以為言。

translations.literal: The Left Vice Director Pei Du submitted three memorials requesting establishment of the heir apparent; Hanlin academicians and officials of both secretariats successively spoke likewise.
translations.idiomatic: Left Vice Director Pei Du submitted three memorials urging the heir apparent's installation; Hanlin academicians and officials of both secretariats spoke in turn to the same effect.

sentences.zh: 居數日，穆宗疾少閒，宰相李逢吉請立景王為皇太子。

translations.literal: After several days Muzong's illness eased somewhat; Chancellor Li Fengji requested that Prince of Jing be established as heir apparent.
translations.idiomatic: After several days Muzong's illness eased slightly; Chancellor Li Fengji asked that Prince of Jing be made heir apparent.

sentences.zh: 四年正月，穆宗崩。

translations.literal: First month of the fourth year, Muzong died.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month of the fourth year Muzong died.

sentences.zh: 癸酉，門下侍郎、平章事李逢吉攝冢宰。

translations.literal: On the day guiyou the vice director of the Chancellery and chancellor Li Fengji acted as overseer of the funeral rites.
translations.idiomatic: On guiyou Li Fengji, vice director of the Chancellery and chancellor, served as acting chief mourner.

sentences.zh: 丙子，皇太子即皇帝位于太極殿。

translations.literal: On the day bingzi the heir apparent ascended the imperial throne at the Hall of Supreme Ultimate.
translations.idiomatic: On bingzi the heir apparent took the throne at the Hall of Supreme Ultimate.

sentences.zh: 二月辛巳，始聽政。

translations.literal: Second month, day xinsi, he began to hear government affairs.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month on xinsi he began to hold court.

sentences.zh: 癸未，尊母為皇太后，皇太后為太皇太后。

translations.literal: On the day guimao his mother was honored as empress dowager and the empress dowager as grand empress dowager.
translations.idiomatic: On guimao his mother was honored as empress dowager and the former empress dowager as grand empress dowager.

sentences.zh: 辛卯，放掖庭內園沒入者。

translations.literal: On the day xinmao those confined in the inner palace and inner park were released.
translations.idiomatic: On xinmao those held in the inner palace and inner park were released.

sentences.zh: 丁未，擊鞠于中和殿。

translations.literal: On the day dingwei he played cuju at the Hall of Central Harmony.
translations.idiomatic: On dingwei he played cuju at the Hall of Central Harmony.

sentences.zh: 戊申，擊鞠于飛龍院。

translations.literal: On the day wushen he played cuju at the Flying Dragon Court.
translations.idiomatic: On wushen he played cuju at the Flying Dragon Court.

sentences.zh: 黃洞蠻降。

translations.literal: The Yellow Cave barbarians surrendered.
translations.idiomatic: The Yellow Cave tribes surrendered.

sentences.zh: 己酉，擊鞠，用樂。

translations.literal: On the day jiyou he played cuju, with music.
translations.idiomatic: On jiyou he played cuju with music.

sentences.zh: 三月壬子，大赦。

translations.literal: Third month, day renzi, great amnesty.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month on renzi a general amnesty was proclaimed.

sentences.zh: 免京畿、河南青苗稅，減宮禁經費、乘輿服膳，罷貢鷹犬。

translations.literal: Green sprout tax in the capital region and Henan was remitted; palace expenses, imperial conveyance, and meals were reduced; tribute of hawks and dogs was halted.
translations.idiomatic: Green sprout tax in the capital region and Henan was remitted; palace, conveyance, and meal expenses were cut; tribute hawks and dogs were halted.

sentences.zh: 元和以來，兩河藩鎮歸地者予一子官。

translations.literal: Since Yuanhe, for each Hebei frontier commissioner who returned territory, one son was granted an office.
translations.idiomatic: Since Yuanhe, one son was granted an office for each Hebei commissioner who returned territory to the throne.

sentences.zh: 庚午，太白經天。

translations.literal: On the day gengwu Venus crossed the sky.
translations.idiomatic: On gengwu Venus crossed the heavens.

sentences.zh: 四月丙申，擊鞠于清思殿。

translations.literal: Fourth month, day bingshen, he played cuju at the Hall of Pure Thought.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month on bingshen he played cuju at the Hall of Pure Thought.

sentences.zh: 染坊匠張韶反，幸左神策軍，韶伏誅。

translations.literal: The dye-works artisan Zhang Shao rebelled; the emperor visited the Left Divine Strategy Army; Shao was executed.
translations.idiomatic: Zhang Shao, a dye-works artisan, rebelled; the emperor fled to the Left Divine Strategy Army and Shao was executed.

sentences.zh: 丁酉，還宮。

translations.literal: On the day dingyou he returned to the palace.
translations.idiomatic: On dingyou he returned to the palace.

sentences.zh: 五月乙卯，吏部侍郎李程、戶部侍郎判度支竇易直同中書門下平章事。

translations.literal: Fifth month, day yimao, the vice minister of personnel Li Cheng and the vice minister of revenue overseeing the budget Dou Yizhi were made chancellors de facto.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month on yimao Li Cheng, vice minister of personnel, and Dou Yizhi, vice minister of revenue overseeing the budget, were appointed chancellors de facto.

sentences.zh: 六月庚辰，大風壞延喜、景風門。

translations.literal: Sixth month, day gengchen, great wind damaged the Yanxi and Jingfeng gates.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month on gengchen a great wind damaged the Yanxi and Jingfeng gates.

sentences.zh: 是夏，漢水溢。

translations.literal: That summer the Han River overflowed.
translations.idiomatic: That summer the Han River flooded.

sentences.zh: 八月丁亥，太白晝見。

translations.literal: Eighth month, day dinghai, Venus was seen in daylight.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month on dinghai Venus was visible in daylight.

sentences.zh: 丁酉，中官季文德謀反，伏誅。

translations.literal: On the day dingyou the eunuch Ji Wendé plotted rebellion and was executed.
translations.idiomatic: On dingyou the eunuch Ji Wendé plotted rebellion and was executed.

sentences.zh: 黃洞蠻寇安南。

translations.literal: The Yellow Cave barbarians raided Annan.
translations.idiomatic: The Yellow Cave tribes raided Annan.

sentences.zh: 十一月戊午，環王及黃洞蠻陷陸州，刺史葛維死之。

translations.literal: Eleventh month, day wuwu, the Huan king and Yellow Cave barbarians captured Luzhou; the prefect Ge Wei died.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month on wuwu the king of Huan and the Yellow Cave tribes captured Lu prefecture; Prefect Ge Wei was killed.

sentences.zh: 庚申，葬睿聖文惠孝皇帝于光陵。

translations.literal: On the day gengshen the Sagely Civil and Gracious Filial Emperor was buried at Guang Mausoleum.
translations.idiomatic: On gengshen the Sagely Civil and Gracious Filial Emperor was buried at Guang Mausoleum.

sentences.zh: 寶曆元年正月己酉，朝獻于太清宮。

translations.literal: First year of Baoli, first month, day jiyou, he offered tribute at the Grand Pure Palace.
translations.idiomatic: In the first year of Baoli, first month, on jiyou he offered tribute at the Grand Pure Palace.

sentences.zh: 庚戌，朝享于太廟。

translations.literal: On the day gengxu he offered sacrifice at the Imperial Ancestral Temple.
translations.idiomatic: On gengxu he sacrificed at the Imperial Ancestral Temple.

sentences.zh: 辛亥，有事于南郊。

translations.literal: On the day xinhai he performed the suburban sacrifice.
translations.idiomatic: On xinhai he performed the suburban sacrifice.

sentences.zh: 大赦，改元。

translations.literal: Great amnesty; the reign title was changed.
translations.idiomatic: A general amnesty was proclaimed and the reign title was changed.

sentences.zh: 乙卯，牛僧孺罷。

translations.literal: On the day yimao Niu Sengru was dismissed.
translations.idiomatic: On yimao Niu Sengru was dismissed.

sentences.zh: 四月癸巳，羣臣上尊號曰文武大聖廣孝皇帝。

translations.literal: Fourth month, day guisi, the ministers offered the honorific title Civil and Martial Great Sage and Broadly Filial Emperor.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month on guisi the ministers offered the honorific Civil and Martial Great Sage and Broadly Filial Emperor.

sentences.zh: 大赦。

translations.literal: Great amnesty.
translations.idiomatic: A general amnesty was proclaimed.

sentences.zh: 賜文武官階、爵。

translations.literal: Civil and military officials were granted ranks and titles.
translations.idiomatic: Ranks and titles were granted to civil and military officials.

sentences.zh: 五月庚戌，觀競渡于魚藻宮。

translations.literal: Fifth month, day gengxu, he watched boat-racing at the Fish-and-Water Palace.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month on gengxu he watched boat races at the Fish-and-Water Palace.

sentences.zh: 九月壬午，昭義軍節度使劉悟卒，其子從諫自稱留後。

translations.literal: Ninth month, day renwu, the Zhaoyi military commissioner Liu Wu died; his son Congjian styled himself acting commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month on renwu Liu Wu of Zhaoyi died; his son Congjian declared himself acting commissioner.

sentences.zh: 十一月丙申，封子普為晉王。

translations.literal: Eleventh month, day bingshen, his son Pu was enfeoffed as Prince of Jin.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month on bingshen his son Pu was enfeoffed as Prince of Jin.

sentences.zh: 二年正月甲戌，發神策六軍穿池于禁中。

translations.literal: Second year, first month, day jiaxu, the six Divine Strategy armies were ordered to dig pools within the Forbidden City.
translations.idiomatic: In the second year, first month, on jiaxu the six Divine Strategy armies were ordered to dig pools within the Forbidden City.

sentences.zh: 二月丁未，山南西道節度使裴度守司空、同中書門下平章事。

translations.literal: Second month, day dingwei, the Shannan West Circuit military commissioner Pei Du was made acting grand mentor and chancellor de facto.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month on dingwei Pei Du of Shannan West was appointed acting grand mentor and chancellor de facto.

sentences.zh: 三月戊寅，觀競渡于魚藻宮。

translations.literal: Third month, day wuyin, he watched boat-racing at the Fish-and-Water Palace.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month on wuyin he watched boat races at the Fish-and-Water Palace.

sentences.zh: 四月戊戌，橫海軍節度使李全略卒，其子同捷反。

translations.literal: Fourth month, day wuxu, the Henghai military commissioner Li Quanlue died; his son Tongjie rebelled.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month on wuxu Li Quanlue of Henghai died; his son Tongjie rebelled.

sentences.zh: 五月戊寅，觀競渡于魚藻宮。

translations.literal: Fifth month, day wuyin, he watched boat-racing at the Fish-and-Water Palace.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month on wuyin he watched boat races at the Fish-and-Water Palace.

sentences.zh: 庚辰，幽州盧龍軍亂，殺其節度使朱克融，其子延嗣自稱節度使。

translations.literal: On the day gengchen the Youzhou Lulong army mutinied and killed its military commissioner Zhu Keyong; his son Yansi styled himself military commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: On gengchen the Youzhou Lulong garrison mutinied and killed Commissioner Zhu Keyong; his son Yansi declared himself commissioner.

sentences.zh: 六月辛酉，觀漁于臨碧池。

translations.literal: Sixth month, day xinyou, he watched fishing at the Jade-Green Pool.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month on xinyou he watched fishing at the Jade-Green Pool.

sentences.zh: 甲子，觀驢鞠、角觝于三殿。

translations.literal: On the day jiazi he watched donkey cuju and wrestling in the Three Halls.
translations.idiomatic: On jiazi he watched donkey cuju and wrestling in the Three Halls.

sentences.zh: 七月癸未，衡王絢薨。

translations.literal: Seventh month, day guimao, Prince of Heng Xuan died.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month on guimao Prince of Heng Xuan died.

sentences.zh: 以渼陂隸尚食，禁民漁。

translations.literal: Mei Pond was placed under the Imperial Kitchen; commoners were forbidden to fish there.
translations.idiomatic: Mei Pond was assigned to the Imperial Kitchen and commoners forbidden to fish there.

sentences.zh: 八月丙午，觀競渡于新池。

translations.literal: Eighth month, day bingwu, he watched boat-racing at the New Pool.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month on bingwu he watched boat races at the New Pool.

sentences.zh: 九月甲戌，觀百戲于宣和殿，三日而罷。

translations.literal: Ninth month, day jiaxu, he watched variety performances at the Hall of Universal Harmony for three days and then stopped.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month on jiaxu he watched variety performances at the Hall of Universal Harmony for three days.

sentences.zh: 戊寅，幽州盧龍軍兵馬使李載義殺朱延嗣，自稱留後。

translations.literal: On the day wuyin the Youzhou Lulong army horse-and-army envoy Li Zaiyi killed Zhu Yansi and styled himself acting commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: On wuyin Li Zaiyi, horse-and-army envoy of Youzhou Lulong, killed Zhu Yansi and declared himself acting commissioner.

sentences.zh: 壬午，李程罷。

translations.literal: On the day renwu Li Cheng was dismissed.
translations.idiomatic: On renwu Li Cheng was dismissed.

sentences.zh: 十一月甲申，李逢吉罷。

translations.literal: Eleventh month, day jiashen, Li Fengji was dismissed.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month on jiashen Li Fengji was dismissed.

sentences.zh: 己丑，禁朝官、方鎮置私白身。

translations.literal: On the day jichou court officials and frontier commissioners were forbidden to keep private retainers.
translations.idiomatic: On jichou court officials and frontier commissioners were forbidden to keep private retainers.

sentences.zh: 十二月，中官劉克明反。

translations.literal: Twelfth month: the eunuch Liu Keming rebelled.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month the eunuch Liu Keming rebelled.

sentences.zh: 辛丑，皇帝崩，年十八。

translations.literal: On the day xinchou the emperor died, aged eighteen.
translations.idiomatic: On xinchou the emperor died, aged eighteen.

sentences.zh: 文宗文宗元聖昭獻孝皇帝諱昂，穆宗第二子也。

translations.literal: __FORCETOC__Emperor Wenzong, Emperor Wenzong the Primordial Sagely and Proclaiming Filial, taboo name Ang, was the second son of Muzong.
translations.idiomatic: __FORCETOC__Emperor Wenzong, posthumously honored as the Primordial Sagely and Proclaiming Filial, bore the taboo name Ang and was the second son of Muzong.

sentences.zh: 母曰貞獻皇太后蕭氏。

translations.literal: His mother was Empress Dowager Zhenxian of the Xiao clan.
translations.idiomatic: His mother was Empress Dowager Zhenxian, née Xiao.

sentences.zh: 始封江王。

translations.literal: He was first enfeoffed as Prince of Jiang.
translations.idiomatic: He was first enfeoffed as Prince of Jiang.

sentences.zh: 寶曆二年十二月，敬宗崩，劉克明等矯詔以絳王悟句當軍國事。

translations.literal: Twelfth month of the second year of Baoli, Jingzong died; Liu Keming and others forged an edict appointing Prince of Jiang Wu to handle military and state affairs.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month of the second year of Baoli Jingzong died; Liu Keming and others forged an edict putting Prince of Jiang Wu in charge of state and military affairs.

sentences.zh: 壬寅，內樞密使王守澄楊承和、神策護軍中尉魏從簡梁守謙奉江王而立之，率神策六軍、飛龍兵誅克明，殺絳王。

translations.literal: On the day renyin the inner palace commissioners Wang Shoucheng and Yang Chenghe and the Divine Strategy army protective eunuch-commanders Wei Congjian and Liang Shouqian installed the Prince of Jiang; they led the six Divine Strategy armies and Flying Dragon troops to execute Keming and kill Prince of Jiang.
translations.idiomatic: On renyin inner commissioners Wang Shoucheng and Yang Chenghe and Divine Strategy protective eunuch-commanders Wei Congjian and Liang Shouqian installed Prince of Jiang; leading the six Divine Strategy armies and Flying Dragon troops they executed Keming and killed Prince of Jiang.

sentences.zh: 乙巳，江王即皇帝位于宣政殿。

translations.literal: On the day yisi the Prince of Jiang ascended the imperial throne at the Hall of Imperial Governance.
translations.idiomatic: On yisi Prince of Jiang took the throne at the Hall of Imperial Governance.

sentences.zh: 戊申，始聽政。

translations.literal: On the day wushen he began to hear government affairs.
translations.idiomatic: On wushen he began to hold court.

sentences.zh: 尊母為皇太后。

translations.literal: His mother was honored as empress dowager.
translations.idiomatic: His mother was honored as empress dowager.

sentences.zh: 庚戌，兵部侍郎、翰林學士韋處厚為中書侍郎、同中書門下平章事。

translations.literal: On the day gengxu the vice minister of war and Hanlin academician Wei Chuhou was made vice director of the Secretariat and chancellor de facto.
translations.idiomatic: On gengxu Wei Chuhou, vice minister of war and Hanlin academician, was appointed vice director of the Secretariat and chancellor de facto.

sentences.zh: 庚申，出宮人三千，省教坊樂工、翰林伎術冗員千二百七十人，縱五坊鷹犬，停貢纂組雕鏤、金筐寶飾牀榻。

translations.literal: On the day gengshen three thousand palace women were released; one thousand two hundred seventy music workers of the Instruction Quarter and Hanlin technical redundancies were cut; hawks and dogs of the Five Paddocks were released; tribute of brocade weaving, carved inlay, gold baskets, and jeweled bed furnishings was halted.
translations.idiomatic: On gengshen three thousand palace women were released; 1,270 redundant music workers of the Instruction Quarter and Hanlin technicians were dismissed; Five Paddock hawks and dogs were released; and tribute of brocade, carved inlay, gold baskets, and jeweled bed furnishings was halted.

sentences.zh: 大和元年二月乙巳，大赦，改元。

translations.literal: First year of Dahe, second month, day yisi, great amnesty; the reign title was changed.
translations.idiomatic: In the first year of Dahe, second month, on yisi a general amnesty was proclaimed and the reign title changed.

sentences.zh: 免京兆今歲夏稅半。

translations.literal: This year's summer tax in the capital region was remitted by half.
translations.idiomatic: Half of this year's summer tax in the capital region was remitted.

sentences.zh: 賜九廟陪位者子孫二階，立功將士階、爵，始封諸王後予一子出身。

translations.literal: Descendants of those attending the Nine Temples were granted two ranks; merit soldiers ranks and titles; newly enfeoffed collateral princes' heirs one son entry into service.
translations.idiomatic: Descendants of Nine Temples attendants received two ranks; merit soldiers received ranks and titles; heirs of newly enfeoffed collateral princes received one son's entry into service.

sentences.zh: 五月戊辰，罷宰臣奏事監搜。

translations.literal: Fifth month, day wuchen, the chancellors' memorial audience body search was abolished.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month on wuchen the body search at chancellors' memorial audiences was abolished.

sentences.zh: 丙子，橫海軍節度使烏重胤討李同捷。

translations.literal: On the day bingzi the Henghai military commissioner Wu Zhongyin campaigned against Li Tongjie.
translations.idiomatic: On bingzi Wu Zhongyin of Henghai campaigned against Li Tongjie.

sentences.zh: 六月癸巳，淮南節度副大使王播為尚書左僕射、同中書門下平章事。

translations.literal: Sixth month, day guisi, the Huainan deputy military commissioner Wang Bo was made Left Vice Director and chancellor de facto.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month on guisi Wang Bo, Huainan deputy commissioner, was appointed Left Vice Director and chancellor de facto.

sentences.zh: 乙卯，以旱降京畿死罪以下。

translations.literal: On the day yimao because of drought capital crimes and below in the capital region were reduced.
translations.idiomatic: On yimao, owing to drought, capital crimes and below in the capital region were pardoned.

sentences.zh: 七月癸酉，葬睿武昭愍孝皇帝于莊陵。

translations.literal: Seventh month, day guiyou, the Sagely Martial and Lamenting Filial Emperor was buried at Zhuang Mausoleum.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month on guiyou the Sagely Martial and Lamenting Filial Emperor was buried at Zhuang Mausoleum.

sentences.zh: 十一月庚辰，橫海軍節度使李寰討李同捷。

translations.literal: Eleventh month, day gengchen, the Henghai military commissioner Li Huan campaigned against Li Tongjie.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month on gengchen Li Huan of Henghai campaigned against Li Tongjie.

sentences.zh: 十二月庚戌，王智興為滄州行營招撫使。

translations.literal: Twelfth month, day gengxu, Wang Zhixing was made pacification commissioner of the Cangzhou campaign.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month on gengxu Wang Zhixing was made pacification commissioner of the Cangzhou campaign.

sentences.zh: 二年正月壬申，地震。

translations.literal: Second year, first month, day renshen, earthquake.
translations.idiomatic: In the second year, first month, on renshen there was an earthquake.

sentences.zh: 六月乙卯，晉王普薨。

translations.literal: Sixth month, day yimao, Prince of Jin Pu died.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month on yimao Prince of Jin Pu died.

sentences.zh: 己巳，大風拔木。

translations.literal: On the day jisi great wind uprooted trees.
translations.idiomatic: On jisi a great wind uprooted trees.

sentences.zh: 乙亥，峯州刺史王昇朝反，伏誅。

translations.literal: On the day yihai the Fengzhou prefect Wang Shengchao rebelled and was executed.
translations.idiomatic: On yihai Prefect Wang Shengchao of Feng rebelled and was executed.

sentences.zh: 是夏，河溢，壞棣州城；

translations.literal: That summer the Yellow River overflowed and destroyed the Dezhou city wall;
translations.idiomatic: That summer the Yellow River flooded and destroyed the walls of De prefecture;

sentences.zh: 越州海溢。

translations.literal: the Yuezhou sea overflowed.
translations.idiomatic: the sea at Yue prefecture overflowed.

sentences.zh: 七月辛丑，魏博節度使史憲誠及同捷戰于平原，敗之。

translations.literal: Seventh month, day xinchou, the Weibo military commissioner Shi Xiancheng fought Li Tongjie at Pingyuan and defeated him.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month on xinchou Shi Xiancheng of Weibo fought Li Tongjie at Pingyuan and defeated him.

sentences.zh: 甲辰，有彗星出于右攝提。

translations.literal: On the day jiachen a comet appeared in the Right Eastern Triangle.
translations.idiomatic: On jiachen a comet appeared in the Right Eastern Triangle.

sentences.zh: 八月己巳，王廷湊反。

translations.literal: Eighth month, day jisi, Wang Tingcou rebelled.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month on jisi Wang Tingcou rebelled.

sentences.zh: 壬申，義武軍節度使柳公濟及廷湊戰于新樂，敗之。

translations.literal: On the day renshen the Yiwu military commissioner Liu Gongji fought Tingcou at Xinle and defeated him.
translations.idiomatic: On renshen Liu Gongji of Yiwu fought Tingcou at Xinle and defeated him.

sentences.zh: 己卯，劉從諫又敗之于臨城。

translations.literal: On the day jimao Liu Congjian again defeated him at Lincheng.
translations.idiomatic: On jimao Liu Congjian again defeated him at Lincheng.

sentences.zh: 辛巳，史憲誠及李同捷戰于平原，敗之。

translations.literal: On the day xinsi Shi Xiancheng and Li Tongjie fought at Pingyuan and defeated him.
translations.idiomatic: On xinsi Shi Xiancheng and Li Tongjie fought at Pingyuan and defeated him.

sentences.zh: 癸未，劉從諫及王廷湊戰于昭慶，敗之。

translations.literal: On the day guimao Liu Congjian and Wang Tingcou fought at Zhaoqing and defeated him.
translations.idiomatic: On guimao Liu Congjian and Wang Tingcou fought at Zhaoqing and defeated him.

sentences.zh: 九月癸卯，柳公濟又敗之于博野。

translations.literal: Ninth month, day guimao, Liu Gongji again defeated him at Boye.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month on guimao Liu Gongji again defeated him at Boye.

sentences.zh: 丁未，岳王緄薨。

translations.literal: On the day dingwei Prince of Yue Xun died.
translations.idiomatic: On dingwei Prince of Yue Xun died.

sentences.zh: 庚戌，安南軍亂，逐其都護韓約。

translations.literal: On the day gengxu the Annan army mutinied and expelled its protector-general Han Yue.
translations.idiomatic: On gengxu the Annan garrison mutinied and expelled Protector-General Han Yue.

sentences.zh: 十月庚申，史憲誠及李同捷戰于平原，敗之。

translations.literal: Tenth month, day gengshen, Shi Xiancheng and Li Tongjie fought at Pingyuan and defeated him.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month on gengshen Shi Xiancheng and Li Tongjie fought at Pingyuan and defeated him.

sentences.zh: 丁卯，洋王忻薨。

translations.literal: On the day dingmao Prince of Yang Xin died.
translations.idiomatic: On dingmao Prince of Yang Xin died.

sentences.zh: 癸酉，竇易直罷。

translations.literal: On the day guiyou Dou Yizhi was dismissed.
translations.idiomatic: On guiyou Dou Yizhi was dismissed.

sentences.zh: 戊寅，史憲誠及李同捷戰于平原，敗之。

translations.literal: On the day wuyin Shi Xiancheng and Li Tongjie fought at Pingyuan and defeated him.
translations.idiomatic: On wuyin Shi Xiancheng and Li Tongjie fought at Pingyuan and defeated him.

sentences.zh: 壬午，幽州盧龍軍節度使李載義又敗之于長蘆。

translations.literal: On the day renwu the Youzhou Lulong military commissioner Li Zaiyi again defeated him at Changlu.
translations.idiomatic: On renwu Li Zaiyi of Youzhou Lulong again defeated him at Changlu.

sentences.zh: 十一月壬辰，給復棣州一年，稟戰士創廢者終身。

translations.literal: Eleventh month, day renchen, De prefecture was granted tax remission for one year; wounded soldiers were granted provisions for life.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month on renchen De prefecture received one year's tax remission; wounded soldiers received lifelong provisions.

sentences.zh: 甲辰，昭德寺火。

translations.literal: On the day jiachen the Zhaode Temple burned.
translations.idiomatic: On jiachen Zhaode Temple burned.

sentences.zh: 十二月乙丑，魏博行營兵馬使丌志沼反。

translations.literal: Twelfth month, day yichou, the Weibo campaign horse-and-army envoy Qi Zhinü rebelled.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month on yichou Qi Zhinü, horse-and-army envoy of the Weibo campaign, rebelled.

sentences.zh: 壬申，韋處厚薨。

translations.literal: On the day renshen Wei Chuhou died.
translations.idiomatic: On renshen Wei Chuhou died.

sentences.zh: 戊寅，兵部侍郎、翰林學士路隋為中書侍郎、同中書門下平章事。

translations.literal: On the day wuyin the vice minister of war and Hanlin academician Lu Sui was made vice director of the Secretariat and chancellor de facto.
translations.idiomatic: On wuyin Lu Sui, vice minister of war and Hanlin academician, was appointed vice director of the Secretariat and chancellor de facto.

sentences.zh: 三年正月丁亥，宣武、河陽兵討丌志沼。

translations.literal: Third year, first month, day dinghai, the Xuanwu and Heyang armies campaigned against Qi Zhinü.
translations.idiomatic: In the third year, first month, on dinghai the armies of Xuanwu and Heyang campaigned against Qi Zhinü.

sentences.zh: 庚子，志沼奔于鎮州。

translations.literal: On the day gengzi Zhinü fled to Zhenzhou.
translations.idiomatic: On gengzi Zhinü fled to Zhen prefecture.

sentences.zh: 三月乙酉，罷教坊日直樂工。

translations.literal: Third month, day yiyou, daily-duty music workers of the Instruction Quarter were abolished.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month on yiyou daily-duty music workers of the Instruction Quarter were abolished.

sentences.zh: 乙巳，以太原兵馬使傅毅為義武軍節度使，義武軍不受命，都知兵馬使張璠自稱節度使。

translations.literal: On the day yisi the Taiyuan horse-and-army envoy Fu Yi was made Yiwu military commissioner; the Yiwu army did not accept the order; the overall horse-and-army envoy Zhang Fan styled himself military commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: On yisi Fu Yi, Taiyuan horse-and-army envoy, was appointed Yiwu commissioner; Yiwu refused the order and Zhang Fan, overall horse-and-army envoy, declared himself commissioner.

sentences.zh: 戊申，以璠為義武軍節度使。

translations.literal: On the day wushen Zhang Fan was made Yiwu military commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: On wushen Zhang Fan was appointed Yiwu military commissioner.

sentences.zh: 四月戊辰，滄景節度使李祐克德州，李同捷降。

translations.literal: Fourth month, day wuchen, the Cangjing military commissioner Li You captured Dezhou; Li Tongjie surrendered.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month on wuchen Li You of Cangjing captured De prefecture; Li Tongjie surrendered.

sentences.zh: 乙亥，滄德宣慰使柏耆以同捷歸于京師，殺之于將陵。

translations.literal: On the day yihai the Cangde comfort commissioner Bai Ji brought Tongjie to the capital and executed him at Jiangling.
translations.idiomatic: On yihai Bai Ji, Cangde comfort commissioner, brought Tongjie to the capital and executed him at Jiangling.

sentences.zh: 五月辛卯，給復滄、景、德、棣四州一年。

translations.literal: Fifth month, day xinmao, Cang, Jing, De, and Di prefectures were granted tax remission for one year.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month on xinmao Cang, Jing, De, and Di prefectures received one year's tax remission.

sentences.zh: 六月甲戌，魏博軍亂，殺其節度使史憲誠，都知兵馬使何進滔自稱留後。

translations.literal: Sixth month, day jiaxu, the Weibo army mutinied and killed its military commissioner Shi Xiancheng; the overall horse-and-army envoy He Jintao styled himself acting commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month on jiaxu the Weibo garrison mutinied and killed Commissioner Shi Xiancheng; He Jintao, overall horse-and-army envoy, declared himself acting commissioner.

sentences.zh: 八月辛亥，以相、衞、澶三州隸相衞節度使，進滔不受命。

translations.literal: Eighth month, day xinhai, Xiang, Wei, and Chan prefectures were placed under the Xiang-Wei military commissioner; Jintao did not accept the order.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month on xinhai Xiang, Wei, and Chan were assigned to the Xiang-Wei commissioner; Jintao refused the order.

sentences.zh: 辛酉，以旱免京畿九縣今歲租。

translations.literal: On the day xinyou because of drought this year's tax in nine capital counties was remitted.
translations.idiomatic: On xinyou, owing to drought, this year's tax in nine capital counties was remitted.

sentences.zh: 壬申，赦王廷湊。

translations.literal: On the day renshen Wang Tingcou was pardoned.
translations.idiomatic: On renshen Wang Tingcou was pardoned.

sentences.zh: 甲戌，吏部侍郎李宗閔同中書門下平章事。

translations.literal: On the day jiaxu the vice minister of personnel Li Zongmin was made chancellor de facto.
translations.idiomatic: On jiaxu Li Zongmin, vice minister of personnel, was appointed chancellor de facto.

sentences.zh: 十月癸丑，仗內火。

translations.literal: Tenth month, day guichou, fire in the inner guard formation.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month on guichou fire broke out in the inner guard formation.

sentences.zh: 十一月壬辰，朝獻于太清宮。

translations.literal: Eleventh month, day renchen, he offered tribute at the Grand Pure Palace.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month on renchen he offered tribute at the Grand Pure Palace.

sentences.zh: 癸巳，朝享于太廟。

translations.literal: On the day guisi he offered sacrifice at the Imperial Ancestral Temple.
translations.idiomatic: On guisi he sacrificed at the Imperial Ancestral Temple.

sentences.zh: 甲午，有事于南郊。

translations.literal: On the day jiawu he performed the suburban sacrifice.
translations.idiomatic: On jiawu he performed the suburban sacrifice.

sentences.zh: 大赦。

translations.literal: Great amnesty.
translations.idiomatic: A general amnesty was proclaimed.

sentences.zh: 詔毋獻難成非常之物，焚絲布撩綾機杼。

translations.literal: An edict forbade presenting difficult or extraordinary items; silk looms for gauze and twill were burned.
translations.idiomatic: An edict forbade presenting difficult or extraordinary tribute; silk looms for gauze and twill were burned.

sentences.zh: 是月，雲南蠻陷巂、邛二州。

translations.literal: In that month the Yunnan barbarians captured Xi and Qiong prefectures.
translations.idiomatic: That month Yunnan tribes captured Xi and Qiong prefectures.

sentences.zh: 十二月丁未，鄂岳、襄鄧、忠武軍伐雲南蠻。

translations.literal: Twelfth month, day dingwei, the E-Yue, Xiang-Deng, and Zhongwu armies campaigned against the Yunnan barbarians.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month on dingwei the armies of E-Yue, Xiang-Deng, and Zhongwu campaigned against Yunnan.

sentences.zh: 庚戌，雲南蠻寇成都，右領軍衞大將軍董重質為左右神策及諸道行營西川都知兵馬使以伐之。

translations.literal: On the day gengxu the Yunnan barbarians raided Chengdu; the Right Army Guard great general Dong Chongzhi was made overall horse-and-army commander of the Left and Right Divine Strategy armies and the multi-circuit Xichuan campaign to attack them.
translations.idiomatic: On gengxu Yunnan raided Chengdu; Dong Chongzhi, great general of the Right Army Guard, was made overall commander of the Left and Right Divine Strategy armies and the multi-circuit Xichuan campaign against them.

sentences.zh: 己未，雲南蠻寇梓州。

translations.literal: On the day jiwei the Yunnan barbarians raided Zizhou.
translations.idiomatic: On jiwei Yunnan raided Zi prefecture.

sentences.zh: 壬戌，寇蜀州。

translations.literal: On the day renxu they raided Shuzhou.
translations.idiomatic: On renxu they raided Shu prefecture.

sentences.zh: 四年正月戊子，封子永為魯王。

translations.literal: Fourth year, first month, day wuzi, his son Yong was enfeoffed as Prince of Lu.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth year, first month, on wuzi his son Yong was enfeoffed as Prince of Lu.

sentences.zh: 辛卯，武昌軍節度使牛僧孺為兵部尚書、同中書門下平章事。

translations.literal: On the day xinmao the Wuchang military commissioner Niu Sengru was made minister of war and chancellor de facto.
translations.idiomatic: On xinmao Niu Sengru of Wuchang was appointed minister of war and chancellor de facto.

sentences.zh: 甲午，王播薨。

translations.literal: On the day jiawu Wang Bo died.
translations.idiomatic: On jiawu Wang Bo died.

sentences.zh: 二月乙卯，興元軍亂，殺其節度使李絳。

translations.literal: Second month, day yimao, the Xingyuan army mutinied and killed its military commissioner Li Jiang.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month on yimao the Xingyuan garrison mutinied and killed Commissioner Li Jiang.

sentences.zh: 三月癸卯，禁京畿弋獵。

translations.literal: Third month, day guimao, hunting and fishing in the capital region were forbidden.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month on guimao hunting and fishing in the capital region were forbidden.

sentences.zh: 四月丁未，奚寇邊，李載義敗之。

translations.literal: Fourth month, day dingwei, the Xi raided the frontier; Li Zaiyi defeated them.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month on dingwei the Xi raided the frontier; Li Zaiyi defeated them.

sentences.zh: 六月丁未，裴度平章軍國重事。

translations.literal: Sixth month, day dingwei, Pei Du was made chancellor overseeing military and state weighty affairs.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month on dingwei Pei Du was made chancellor overseeing military and state affairs.

sentences.zh: 是夏，舒州江溢。

translations.literal: That summer the Shu prefecture river overflowed.
translations.idiomatic: That summer the river at Shu prefecture flooded.

sentences.zh: 七月癸未，尚書右丞宋申錫同中書門下平章事。

translations.literal: Seventh month, day guimao, the Right Vice Director Song Shenxi was made chancellor de facto.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month on guimao Song Shenxi, Right Vice Director, was appointed chancellor de facto.

sentences.zh: 九月壬午，裴度罷。

translations.literal: Ninth month, day renwu, Pei Du was dismissed.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month on renwu Pei Du was dismissed.

sentences.zh: 五年正月庚申，幽州盧龍軍亂，逐其節度使李載義，殺莫州刺史張慶初，兵馬使楊志誠自稱留後。

translations.literal: Fifth year, first month, day gengshen, the Youzhou Lulong army mutinied, expelled its military commissioner Li Zaiyi, killed the Mo prefect Wang Qingchu; the horse-and-army envoy Yang Zhicheng styled himself acting commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth year, first month, on gengshen the Youzhou Lulong garrison mutinied, expelled Commissioner Li Zaiyi, and killed Mo Prefect Wang Qingchu; Yang Zhicheng, horse-and-army envoy, declared himself acting commissioner.

sentences.zh: 三月庚子，貶宋申錫為太子右庶子。

translations.literal: Third month, day gengzi, Song Shenxi was demoted to Right Vice Mentor of the Heir Apparent.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month on gengzi Song Shenxi was demoted to right vice mentor of the heir apparent.

sentences.zh: 癸卯，降封漳王湊為巢縣公。

translations.literal: On the day guimao Prince of Zhang Cou was reduced and enfeoffed as Duke of Chao county.
translations.idiomatic: On guimao Prince of Zhang Cou was demoted to Duke of Chao county.

sentences.zh: 六月甲午，梓州玄武江溢。

translations.literal: Sixth month, day jiawu, the Xuanwu River at Zizhou overflowed.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month on jiawu the Xuanwu River at Zi prefecture flooded.

sentences.zh: 六年正月壬子，降死罪以下。

translations.literal: Sixth year, first month, day renzi, capital crimes and below were reduced.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth year, first month, on renzi capital crimes and below were pardoned.

sentences.zh: 二月，蘇州地震，生白毛。

translations.literal: Second month: Suzhou earthquake; white hair grew.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month Suzhou was shaken by an earthquake and white hair grew on the ground.

sentences.zh: 五月庚申，給民疫死者棺，十歲以下不能自存者二月糧。

translations.literal: Fifth month, day gengshen, coffins were granted to those who died of plague; those under ten who could not support themselves received two months' grain.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month on gengshen coffins were granted to plague victims; children under ten who could not support themselves received two months' grain.

sentences.zh: 七月戊申，原王逵薨。

translations.literal: Seventh month, day wushen, Prince of Yuan Kui died.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month on wushen Prince of Yuan Kui died.

sentences.zh: 十一月甲子，立魯王永為皇太子。

translations.literal: Eleventh month, day jiazi, Prince of Lu Yong was established as heir apparent.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month on jiazi Prince of Lu Yong was made heir apparent.

sentences.zh: 十二月乙丑，牛僧孺罷。

translations.literal: Twelfth month, day yichou, Niu Sengru was dismissed.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month on yichou Niu Sengru was dismissed.

sentences.zh: 己巳，珍王諴薨。

translations.literal: On the day jisi Prince of Zhen Yan died.
translations.idiomatic: On jisi Prince of Zhen Yan died.

sentences.zh: 七年正月壬辰，罷吳、蜀冬貢茶。

translations.literal: Seventh year, first month, day renchen, winter tribute tea from Wu and Shu was halted.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh year, first month, on renchen winter tribute tea from Wu and Shu was halted.

sentences.zh: 二月丙戌，兵部尚書李德裕同中書門下平章事。

translations.literal: Second month, day bingxu, the minister of war Li Deyu was made chancellor de facto.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month on bingxu Li Deyu, minister of war, was appointed chancellor de facto.

sentences.zh: 三月辛卯，幽州盧龍軍節度使楊志誠執春衣使邊奉鸞、送奚契丹使尹士恭。

translations.literal: Third month, day xinmao, the Youzhou Lulong military commissioner Yang Zhicheng seized the spring-clothing envoy Bian Fengluan and the Xi-Khitan envoy Yin Shigong.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month on xinmao Yang Zhicheng of Youzhou Lulong seized spring-clothing envoy Bian Fengluan and the Xi-Khitan envoy Yin Shigong.

sentences.zh: 辛丑，和王綺薨。

translations.literal: On the day xinchou Prince of He Qi died.
translations.idiomatic: On xinchou Prince of He Qi died.

sentences.zh: 六月甲戌，地震。

translations.literal: Sixth month, day jiaxu, earthquake.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month on jiaxu there was an earthquake.

sentences.zh: 乙亥，李宗閔罷。

translations.literal: On the day yihai Li Zongmin was dismissed.
translations.idiomatic: On yihai Li Zongmin was dismissed.

sentences.zh: 七月壬寅，尚書右僕射、諸道鹽鐵轉運使王涯同中書門下平章事。

translations.literal: Seventh month, day renyin, the Right Vice Director and salt and iron transport commissioner Wang Ya was made chancellor de facto.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month on renyin Wang Ya, Right Vice Director and salt and iron transport commissioner, was appointed chancellor de facto.

sentences.zh: 閏月乙卯，以旱避正殿，減膳，徹樂，出宮女千人，縱五坊鷹犬。

translations.literal: Intercalary month, day yimao, because of drought he avoided the main hall, reduced meals, halted music, released one thousand palace women, and released hawks and dogs of the Five Paddocks.
translations.idiomatic: In the intercalary month on yimao, owing to drought, he avoided the main hall, reduced meals, halted music, released a thousand palace women, and released Five Paddock hawks and dogs.

sentences.zh: 八月庚寅，降死罪以下。

translations.literal: Eighth month, day gengyin, capital crimes and below were reduced.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month on gengyin capital crimes and below were pardoned.

sentences.zh: 賜文武及州府長官子為父後者勳兩轉。

translations.literal: Civil and military officials and prefectural commissioners' sons who succeeded their fathers were granted two merit turns.
translations.idiomatic: Two merit turns were granted to civil and military officials and to sons who succeeded their fathers among prefectural commissioners.

sentences.zh: 十二月庚子，不豫。

translations.literal: Twelfth month, day gengzi, he was unwell.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month on gengzi he fell ill.

sentences.zh: 八年二月壬午朔，日有食之。

translations.literal: Eighth year, second month, first day renwu, there was an eclipse of the sun.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth year, second month, on the first day renwu, there was a solar eclipse.

sentences.zh: 庚寅，以疾愈，降死罪以下。

translations.literal: On the day gengyin because his illness had eased, capital crimes and below were reduced.
translations.idiomatic: On gengyin, as his illness had eased, capital crimes and below were pardoned.

sentences.zh: 四月丙戌，詔笞罪毋鞭背。

translations.literal: Fourth month, day bingxu, an edict ordered that flogging offenses should not strike the back.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month on bingxu an edict forbade flogging the back in corporal punishment.

sentences.zh: 五月己巳，飛龍、神駒中廄火。

translations.literal: Fifth month, day jisi, the Flying Dragon and Divine Colt inner stables burned.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month on jisi the Flying Dragon and Divine Colt inner stables burned.

sentences.zh: 六月丙戌，莒王紓薨。

translations.literal: Sixth month, day bingxu, Prince of Ju Shu died.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month on bingxu Prince of Ju Shu died.

sentences.zh: 七月辛酉，震定陵寢宮。

translations.literal: Seventh month, day xinyou, the Ding Mausoleum palace buildings were shaken.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month on xinyou the Ding Mausoleum palace buildings were shaken.

sentences.zh: 癸亥，郯王經薨。

translations.literal: On the day guihai Prince of Tan Jing died.
translations.idiomatic: On guihai Prince of Tan Jing died.

sentences.zh: 九月辛亥，有彗星出于太微。

translations.literal: Ninth month, day xinhai, a comet appeared in Supreme Palace Enclosure.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month on xinhai a comet appeared in the Supreme Palace Enclosure.

sentences.zh: 十月辛巳，幽州盧龍軍大將史元忠逐其節度使楊志誠，自稱權句當節度兵馬。

translations.literal: Tenth month, day xinsi, the Youzhou Lulong army great general Shi Yuanzhong expelled its military commissioner Yang Zhicheng and styled himself acting commissioner of frontier horse-and-army.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month on xinsi Shi Yuanzhong, a great general of Youzhou Lulong, expelled Commissioner Yang Zhicheng and declared himself acting frontier commissioner.

sentences.zh: 庚寅，山南西道節度使李宗閔為中書侍郎、同中書門下平章事。

translations.literal: On the day gengyin the Shannan West Circuit military commissioner Li Zongmin was made vice director of the Secretariat and chancellor de facto.
translations.idiomatic: On gengyin Li Zongmin of Shannan West was appointed vice director of the Secretariat and chancellor de facto.

sentences.zh: 甲午，李德裕罷。

translations.literal: On the day jiawu Li Deyu was dismissed.
translations.idiomatic: On jiawu Li Deyu was dismissed.

sentences.zh: 十一月癸丑，成德軍節度使王廷湊卒，其子元逵自稱權句當節度事。

translations.literal: Eleventh month, day guichou, the Chengde military commissioner Wang Tingcou died; his son Yuankui styled himself acting commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month on guichou Wang Tingcou of Chengde died; his son Yuankui declared himself acting commissioner.

sentences.zh: 丙子，莫州軍亂，逐其刺史張惟汎。

translations.literal: On the day bingzi the Mozhou army mutinied and expelled its prefect Zhang Weifan.
translations.idiomatic: On bingzi the Mo prefecture garrison mutinied and expelled Prefect Zhang Weifan.

sentences.zh: 十二月己卯，降京畿死罪以下。

translations.literal: Twelfth month, day jimao, capital crimes and below in the capital region were reduced.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month on jimao capital crimes and below in the capital region were pardoned.

sentences.zh: 九年正月癸亥，巢縣公湊薨。

translations.literal: Ninth year, first month, day guihai, Duke of Chao county Cou died.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth year, first month, on guihai Duke of Chao county Cou died.

sentences.zh: 二月辛亥，冀王絿薨。

translations.literal: Second month, day xinhai, Prince of Ji Hao died.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month on xinhai Prince of Ji Hao died.

sentences.zh: 乙卯，京師地震。

translations.literal: On the day yimao the capital earthquake.
translations.idiomatic: On yimao the capital was shaken by an earthquake.

sentences.zh: 四月丙申，路隋罷。

translations.literal: Fourth month, day bingshen, Lu Sui was dismissed.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month on bingshen Lu Sui was dismissed.

sentences.zh: 戊戌，浙江東道觀察使賈餗為中書侍郎、同中書門下平章事。

translations.literal: On the day wuxu the Zhejiang East Circuit observation commissioner Jia Su was made vice director of the Secretariat and chancellor de facto.
translations.idiomatic: On wuxu Jia Su, observation commissioner of Zhejiang East, was appointed vice director of the Secretariat and chancellor de facto.

sentences.zh: 辛丑，大風拔木，落含元殿鴟尾，壞門觀。

translations.literal: On the day xinchou great wind uprooted trees, knocked down the Hall of Universal Concordance ridge ornaments, and damaged gate towers.
translations.idiomatic: On xinchou a great wind uprooted trees, knocked down the Hall of Universal Concordance ridge ornaments, and damaged gate towers.
