sentences.zh: 五月辛未，王涯為司空。

translations.literal: Fifth month, day xinwei, Wang Ya was made minister of works.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month on xinwei Wang Ya was appointed minister of works.

sentences.zh: 六月壬寅，貶李宗閔為明州刺史。

translations.literal: Sixth month, day renyin, Li Zongmin was demoted to prefect of Ming.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month on renyin Li Zongmin was demoted to prefect of Ming.

sentences.zh: 七月辛亥，御史大夫李固言為門下侍郎、同中書門下平章事。

translations.literal: Seventh month, day xinhai, the censor-in-chief Li Guyán was made vice director of the Chancellery and chancellor de facto.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month on xinhai Li Guyán, censor-in-chief, was appointed vice director of the Chancellery and chancellor de facto.

sentences.zh: 九月癸亥，殺陳弘志。

translations.literal: Ninth month, day guihai, Chen Hongzhi was executed.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month on guihai Chen Hongzhi was executed.

sentences.zh: 丁卯，李固言罷。

translations.literal: On the day dingmao Li Guyán was dismissed.
translations.idiomatic: On dingmao Li Guyán was dismissed.

sentences.zh: 己巳，御史中丞舒元輿為刑部侍郎，翰林學士、兵部郎中李訓為禮部侍郎：同中書門下平章事。

translations.literal: On the day jisi the censor-in-chief Shu Yuanyu was made vice minister of justice, and the Hanlin academician and bureau director Li Xun was made vice minister of rites: chancellors de facto.
translations.idiomatic: On jisi Shu Yuanyu, censor-in-chief, was appointed vice minister of justice, and Li Xun, Hanlin academician and bureau director, vice minister of rites: both chancellors de facto.

sentences.zh: 十月辛巳，殺觀軍容使王守澄。

translations.literal: Tenth month, day xinsi, the army supervisory commissioner Wang Shoucheng was executed.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month on xinsi army supervisory commissioner Wang Shoucheng was executed.

sentences.zh: 十一月乙巳，殺武寧軍監軍使王守涓。

translations.literal: Eleventh month, day yisi, the Wuning army supervisory commissioner Wang Shoujuan was executed.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month on yisi Wuning army supervisory commissioner Wang Shoujuan was executed.

sentences.zh: 壬戌，李訓及河東節度使王璠、邠寧節度使郭行餘、御史中丞李孝本、京兆少尹羅立言謀誅中官，不克，訓奔于鳳翔。

translations.literal: On the day renxu Li Xun and the Hedong military commissioner Wang Fan, the Binning military commissioner Guo Xingyu, the censor-in-chief Li Xiaoben, and the Jingzhao junior yin Luo Liyan plotted to execute the eunuchs but failed; Xun fled to Fengxiang.
translations.idiomatic: On renxu Li Xun, Wang Fan of Hedong, Guo Xingyu of Binning, Li Xiaoben, censor-in-chief, and Luo Liyan, junior yin of Jingzhao, plotted to kill the eunuchs but failed; Xun fled to Fengxiang.

sentences.zh: 甲子，尚書右僕射鄭覃同中書門下平章事。

translations.literal: On the day jiazi the Right Vice Director Zheng Tan was made chancellor de facto.
translations.idiomatic: On jiazi Zheng Tan, Right Vice Director, was appointed chancellor de facto.

sentences.zh: 乙丑，權知戶部侍郎李石同中書門下平章事。

translations.literal: On the day yichou the acting vice minister of revenue Li Shi was made chancellor de facto.
translations.idiomatic: On yichou Li Shi, acting vice minister of revenue, was appointed chancellor de facto.

sentences.zh: 左神策軍中尉仇士良殺王涯、賈餗、舒元輿、李孝本、羅立言、王璠、郭行餘、鳳翔少尹魏逢。

translations.literal: The Left Divine Strategy Army eunuch-commander Qiu Shiliang executed Wang Ya, Jia Su, Shu Yuanyu, Li Xiaoben, Luo Liyan, Wang Fan, Guo Xingyu, and the Fengxiang junior yin Wei Feng.
translations.idiomatic: Qiu Shiliang, eunuch-commander of the Left Divine Strategy Army, executed Wang Ya, Jia Su, Shu Yuanyu, Li Xiaoben, Luo Liyan, Wang Fan, Guo Xingyu, and Wei Feng, junior yin of Fengxiang.

sentences.zh: 戊辰，晝晦。

translations.literal: On the day wuchen daylight dimmed.
translations.idiomatic: On wuchen daylight dimmed.

sentences.zh: 鳳翔監軍使張仲清殺其節度使鄭注。

translations.literal: The Fengxiang army supervisory commissioner Zhang Zhongqing executed its military commissioner Zheng Zhu.
translations.idiomatic: Zhang Zhongqing, Fengxiang army supervisory commissioner, executed Commissioner Zheng Zhu.

sentences.zh: 己巳，仇士良殺右金吾衞大將軍韓約。

translations.literal: On the day jisi Qiu Shiliang executed the Right Golden Guard great general Han Yue.
translations.idiomatic: On jisi Qiu Shiliang executed Han Yue, great general of the Right Golden Guard.

sentences.zh: 十二月壬申，殺左金吾衞將軍李貞素、翰林學士顧師邕。

translations.literal: Twelfth month, day renshen, the Left Golden Guard general Li Zhensu and the Hanlin academician Gu Shiyong were executed.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month on renshen Left Golden Guard general Li Zhensu and Hanlin academician Gu Shiyong were executed.

sentences.zh: 丁亥，降京師死罪以下。

translations.literal: On the day dinghai capital crimes and below in the capital were reduced.
translations.idiomatic: On dinghai capital crimes and below in the capital were pardoned.

sentences.zh: 開成元年正月辛丑朔，日有食之。

translations.literal: First year of Kaicheng, first month, first day xinchou, there was an eclipse of the sun.
translations.idiomatic: In the first year of Kaicheng, first month, on the first day xinchou, there was a solar eclipse.

sentences.zh: 大赦，改元。

translations.literal: Great amnesty; the reign title was changed.
translations.idiomatic: A general amnesty was proclaimed and the reign title changed.

sentences.zh: 免大和五年以前逋負、京畿今歲稅，賜文武官階、爵。

translations.literal: Arrears before the fifth year of Dahe and this year's tax in the capital region were remitted; civil and military officials were granted ranks and titles.
translations.idiomatic: Arrears before the fifth year of Dahe and this year's capital tax were remitted; ranks and titles were granted to civil and military officials.

sentences.zh: 二月乙亥，停獻鷙鳥、畋犬。

translations.literal: Second month, day yihai, tribute of fierce birds and hunting dogs was halted.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month on yihai tribute of fierce birds and hunting dogs was halted.

sentences.zh: 三月，京師地震。

translations.literal: Third month: the capital earthquake.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month the capital was shaken by an earthquake.

sentences.zh: 四月辛卯，淄王恊薨。

translations.literal: Fourth month, day xinmao, Prince of Zi Xie died.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month on xinmao Prince of Zi Xie died.

sentences.zh: 甲午，山南西道節度使李固言為門下侍郎、同中書門下平章事。

translations.literal: On the day jiawu the Shannan West Circuit military commissioner Li Guyán was made vice director of the Chancellery and chancellor de facto.
translations.idiomatic: On jiawu Li Guyán of Shannan West was appointed vice director of the Chancellery and chancellor de facto.

sentences.zh: 七月，滹沱溢。

translations.literal: Seventh month: the Hutuo overflowed.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month the Hutuo flooded.

sentences.zh: 乙亥，雨土。

translations.literal: On the day yihai earth rained.
translations.idiomatic: On yihai earth fell like rain.

sentences.zh: 十二月己未，漵王縱薨。

translations.literal: Twelfth month, day jiwei, Prince of Xu Zong died.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month on jiwei Prince of Xu Zong died.

sentences.zh: 二年二月丙午，有彗星出于東方。

translations.literal: Second year, second month, day bingwu, a comet appeared in the east.
translations.idiomatic: In the second year, second month, on bingwu a comet appeared in the east.

sentences.zh: 己未，均王緯薨。

translations.literal: On the day jiwei Prince of Jun Wei died.
translations.idiomatic: On jiwei Prince of Jun Wei died.

sentences.zh: 三月丙寅，以彗見減膳。

translations.literal: Third month, day bingyin, because of the comet meals were reduced.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month on bingyin meals were reduced because of the comet.

sentences.zh: 壬申，素服避正殿，徹樂。

translations.literal: On the day renshen he wore plain dress and avoided the main hall; music was halted.
translations.idiomatic: On renshen he wore plain dress, avoided the main hall, and halted music.

sentences.zh: 降死罪，流以下原之。

translations.idiomatic: His mother was posthumously honored as empress dowager.

translations.idiomatic: The Uyghurs raided Hengshui stockade and plundered Tiande and Zhenwu.

sentences.zh: 十二月，封子嶧為德王，嵯昌王。

translations.literal: Twelfth month: his sons Jun was enfeoffed as Prince of De, and Cui as Prince of Chang.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month his son Jun was enfeoffed as Prince of De and Cui as Prince of Chang.

sentences.zh: 癸未，京師地震。

translations.literal: On the day guimao the capital earthquake.
translations.idiomatic: On guimao the capital was shaken by an earthquake.

sentences.zh: 三年正月庚子，天德軍行營副使石雄及回鶻戰于殺胡山，敗之。

translations.literal: Third year, first month, day gengzi, the Tiande campaign deputy Shi Xiong fought the Uyghurs at Kill-Hu Mountain and defeated them.
translations.idiomatic: In the third year, first month, on gengzi Shi Xiong, Tiande campaign deputy, fought the Uyghurs at Kill-Hu Mountain and defeated them.

sentences.zh: 二月庚申朔，日有食之。

translations.literal: Second month, first day gengshen, there was an eclipse of the sun.
translations.idiomatic: On the first day of the second month, gengshen, there was a solar eclipse.

sentences.zh: 辛未，崔珙罷。

translations.literal: On the day xinwei Cui Gong was dismissed.
translations.idiomatic: On xinwei Cui Gong was dismissed.

sentences.zh: 是春，大雨雪。

translations.literal: That spring heavy rain and snow.
translations.idiomatic: That spring brought heavy rain and snow.

sentences.zh: 四月乙丑，昭義軍節度使劉從諫卒，其子稹自稱留後。

translations.literal: Fourth month, day yichou, the Zhaoyi military commissioner Liu Congjian died; his son Zhen styled himself acting commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month on yichou Liu Congjian of Zhaoyi died; his son Zhen declared himself acting commissioner.

sentences.zh: 五月甲午，震，東都廣運樓災。

translations.literal: Fifth month, day jiawu, earthquake; the Eastern Capital Broad Transport Tower burned.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month on jiawu there was an earthquake and the Eastern Capital Broad Transport Tower burned.

sentences.zh: 辛丑，成德軍節度使王元逵為北面招討澤潞使，魏博節度使何弘敬為東面招討澤潞使，及河中節度使陳夷行、河陽節度使王茂元、劉沔以討劉稹。

translations.literal: On the day xinchou the Chengde military commissioner Wang Yuankui was made northern campaign commissioner against Ze and Lu; the Weibo military commissioner He Hongjing eastern campaign commissioner; together with the Zhonghe military commissioner Chen Yixing, Heyang military commissioner Wang Maoyuan, and Liu Mian to campaign against Liu Zhen.
translations.idiomatic: On xinchou Wang Yuankui of Chengde was made northern Ze-Lu campaign commissioner; He Hongjing of Weibo eastern commissioner; and Chen Yixing of Zhonghe, Wang Maoyuan of Heyang, and Liu Mian marched against Liu Zhen.

sentences.zh: 戊申，翰林學士承旨、中書舍人崔鉉為中書侍郎、同中書門下平章事。

translations.literal: On the day wushen the Hanlin academician-in-chief and Secretariat drafting officer Cui Xuan was made vice director of the Secretariat and chancellor de facto.
translations.idiomatic: On wushen Cui Xuan, Hanlin academician-in-chief and drafting officer, was appointed vice director of the Secretariat and chancellor de facto.

sentences.zh: 武寧軍節度使李彥佐為晉絳行營諸軍節度招討使。

translations.literal: The Wuning military commissioner Li Yanzhuo was made Jin-He campaign military commissioner and campaign commander.
translations.idiomatic: Li Yanzhuo of Wuning was made Jin-He campaign military commissioner and commander.

sentences.zh: 六月，西內神龍寺火。

translations.literal: Sixth month: the Western Inner Palace Divine Dragon Temple burned.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month the Western Inner Palace Divine Dragon Temple burned.

sentences.zh: 辛酉，李德裕為司徒。

translations.literal: On the day xinyou Li Deyu was made grand mentor.
translations.idiomatic: On xinyou Li Deyu was appointed grand mentor.

sentences.zh: 是夏，作望仙觀于禁中。

translations.literal: That summer the Gaze-on-Immortals Abbey was built within the Forbidden City.
translations.idiomatic: That summer the Gaze-on-Immortals Abbey was built within the Forbidden City.

sentences.zh: 七月庚子，免河東今歲秋稅。

translations.literal: Seventh month, day gengzi, this year's autumn tax in Hedong was remitted.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month on gengzi this year's autumn tax in Hedong was remitted.

sentences.zh: 九月辛卯，忠武軍節度使王宰兼河陽行營攻討使。

translations.literal: Ninth month, day xinmao, the Zhongwu military commissioner Wang Zai was also made Heyang campaign attack commander.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month on xinmao Wang Zai of Zhongwu was also made Heyang campaign attack commander.

sentences.zh: 丁未，以雨霖，理囚，免京兆府秋稅。

translations.literal: On the day dingwei because of prolonged rain prisoners were reviewed and autumn tax in the capital prefecture was remitted.
translations.idiomatic: On dingwei, owing to prolonged rain, prisoners were reviewed and autumn tax in the capital prefecture remitted.

sentences.zh: 十月己巳，晉絳行營節度使石雄及劉稹戰于烏嶺，敗之。

translations.literal: Tenth month, day jisi, the Jin-He campaign military commissioner Shi Xiong fought Liu Zhen at Black Ridge and defeated him.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month on jisi Shi Xiong of the Jin-He campaign fought Liu Zhen at Black Ridge and defeated him.

sentences.zh: 壬午，日中月食太白。

translations.literal: On the day renwu at midday the moon eclipsed Venus.
translations.idiomatic: On renwu at midday the moon eclipsed Venus.

sentences.zh: 是月，党項羌寇鹽州。

translations.literal: In that month the Tangut raided Yan prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: That month the Tangut raided Yan prefecture.

sentences.zh: 十一月，寇邠、寧。

translations.literal: Eleventh month: they raided Bin and Ning.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month they raided Bin and Ning.

sentences.zh: 兗王岐為靈夏六道元帥、安撫党項大使，御史中丞李回副之。

translations.literal: Prince of Yan Qi was made overall commander of the six Ling-Xia circuits and pacification commissioner for the Tangut; the censor-in-chief Li Hui was his deputy.
translations.idiomatic: Prince of Yan Qi was made overall commander of the six Ling-Xia circuits and Tangut pacification commissioner; Li Hui, censor-in-chief, served as deputy.

sentences.zh: 安南軍亂，逐其經略使武渾。

translations.literal: The Annan army mutinied and expelled its pacification commissioner Wu Hun.
translations.idiomatic: The Annan garrison mutinied and expelled Pacification Commissioner Wu Hun.

sentences.zh: 十二月丁巳，王宰克天井關。

translations.literal: Twelfth month, day dingsi, Wang Zai captured the Heavenly Well Pass.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month on dingsi Wang Zai captured Heavenly Well Pass.

sentences.zh: 四年正月乙酉，河東將楊弁逐其節度使李石。

translations.literal: Fourth year, first month, day yiyou, the Hedong officer Yang Bian expelled its military commissioner Li Shi.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth year, first month, on yiyou Hedong officer Yang Bian expelled Commissioner Li Shi.

sentences.zh: 二月甲寅朔，日有食之。

translations.literal: Second month, first day jiayin, there was an eclipse of the sun.
translations.idiomatic: On the first day of the second month, jiayin, there was a solar eclipse.

sentences.zh: 辛酉，楊弁伏誅。

translations.literal: On the day xinyou Yang Bian was executed.
translations.idiomatic: On xinyou Yang Bian was executed.

sentences.zh: 三月，石雄兼冀氏行營攻討使，晉州刺史李丕副之。

translations.literal: Third month: Shi Xiong was also made Ji clan campaign attack commander; the Jin prefect Li Pi was his deputy.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month Shi Xiong was also made Ji clan campaign attack commander with Li Pi, prefect of Jin, as deputy.

sentences.zh: 六月己未，中書、門下、御史臺慮囚。

translations.literal: Sixth month, day jiwei, the Secretariat, Chancellery, and Censorate reviewed prisoners.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month on jiwei the Secretariat, Chancellery, and Censorate reviewed prisoners.

sentences.zh: 閏七月壬戌，李紳罷。

translations.literal: Intercalary seventh month, day renxu, Li Shen was dismissed.
translations.idiomatic: In the intercalary seventh month on renxu Li Shen was dismissed.

sentences.zh: 淮南節度副大使杜悰為尚書右僕射，兼中書侍郎、同中書門下平章事。

translations.literal: The Huainan deputy military commissioner Du Cong was made Right Vice Director and concurrently vice director of the Secretariat and chancellor de facto.
translations.idiomatic: Du Cong, Huainan deputy commissioner, was appointed Right Vice Director and vice director of the Secretariat and chancellor de facto.

sentences.zh: 丙子，昭義軍將裴問及邢州刺史崔嘏以城降。

translations.literal: On the day bingzi the Zhaoyi army officer Pei Wen and the Xing prefect Cui Gai surrendered their cities.
translations.idiomatic: On bingzi Zhaoyi officer Pei Wen and Xing Prefect Cui Gai surrendered their cities.

sentences.zh: 是月，洺州刺史王釗、磁州刺史安玉以城降。

translations.literal: In that month the Luo prefect Wang Zhao and the Ci prefect An Yu surrendered their cities.
translations.idiomatic: That month Luo Prefect Wang Zhao and Ci Prefect An Yu surrendered their cities.

sentences.zh: 八月乙未，昭義軍將郭誼殺劉稹以降。

translations.literal: Eighth month, day yiwei, the Zhaoyi army officer Guo Yi killed Liu Zhen and surrendered.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month on yiwei Zhaoyi officer Guo Yi killed Liu Zhen and surrendered.

sentences.zh: 戊戌，給復澤、潞、邢、洺、磁五州一歲，免太原、河陽及懷、陝、晉、絳四州秋稅。

translations.literal: On the day wushen Ze, Lu, Xing, Luo, and Ci prefectures were granted tax remission for one year; autumn tax in Taiyuan, Heyang, and Huai, Shan, Jin, and Jiang prefectures was remitted.
translations.idiomatic: On wushen Ze, Lu, Xing, Luo, and Ci received one year's tax remission; autumn tax was remitted in Taiyuan, Heyang, Huai, Shan, Jin, and Jiang.

sentences.zh: 戊申，李德裕為太尉。

translations.literal: On the day wushen Li Deyu was made grand preceptor.
translations.idiomatic: On wushen Li Deyu was appointed grand preceptor.

sentences.zh: 十月，獵于鄠縣。

translations.literal: Tenth month: he hunted at E county.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month he hunted at E county.

sentences.zh: 十二月，獵于雲陽。

translations.literal: Twelfth month: he hunted at Yunyang.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month he hunted at Yunyang.

sentences.zh: 五年正月己酉，羣臣上尊號曰仁聖文武章天成功神德明道大孝皇帝。

translations.literal: Fifth year, first month, day jiyou, the ministers offered the honorific title Benevolent Sagely Civil and Martial, Manifest Heaven, Successful Spirit, Virtuous Way, and Greatly Filial Emperor.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth year, first month, on jiyou the ministers offered the honorific Benevolent Sagely Civil and Martial, Manifest Heaven, Successful Spirit, Virtuous Way, and Greatly Filial Emperor.

sentences.zh: 是日，朝獻于太清宮。

translations.literal: That day he offered tribute at the Grand Pure Palace.
translations.idiomatic: That day he offered tribute at the Grand Pure Palace.

sentences.zh: 庚戌，朝享于太廟。

translations.literal: On the day gengxu he offered sacrifice at the Imperial Ancestral Temple.
translations.idiomatic: On gengxu he sacrificed at the Imperial Ancestral Temple.

sentences.zh: 辛亥，有事于南郊。

translations.literal: On the day xinhai he performed the suburban sacrifice.
translations.idiomatic: On xinhai he performed the suburban sacrifice.

sentences.zh: 大赦，賜文武官階、勳、爵，文宣公、二王、三恪予一子出身。

translations.literal: Great amnesty; civil and military officials were granted ranks and merit titles; the Duke of Literary Accomplishment, the two Zhou and Shang lines, and the three former dynasties were each granted one son entry into service.
translations.idiomatic: A general amnesty was proclaimed; ranks and merit titles were granted to officials; and one son each of the Duke of Literary Accomplishment, the Zhou and Shang lines, and the three former dynasties received entry into service.

sentences.zh: 作仙臺于南郊。

translations.literal: The Immortal Terrace was built at the southern suburb.
translations.idiomatic: The Immortal Terrace was built at the southern suburb.

sentences.zh: 庚申，皇太后崩。

translations.literal: On the day gengshen the empress dowager died.
translations.idiomatic: On gengshen the empress dowager died.

sentences.zh: 三月，旱。

translations.literal: Third month: drought.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month there was drought.

sentences.zh: 五月壬子，葬恭僖皇太后于光陵。

translations.literal: Fifth month, day renzi, Empress Dowager Gongxi was buried at Guang Mausoleum.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month on renzi Empress Dowager Gongxi was buried at Guang Mausoleum.

sentences.zh: 壬戌，杜悰、崔鉉罷。

translations.literal: On the day renxu Du Cong and Cui Xuan were dismissed.
translations.idiomatic: On renxu Du Cong and Cui Xuan were dismissed.

sentences.zh: 乙丑，戶部侍郎李回為中書侍郎、同中書門下平章事。

translations.literal: On the day yichou the vice minister of revenue Li Hui was made vice director of the Secretariat and chancellor de facto.
translations.idiomatic: On yichou Li Hui, vice minister of revenue, was appointed vice director of the Secretariat and chancellor de facto.

sentences.zh: 六月甲申，作望仙樓于神策軍。

translations.literal: Sixth month, day jiashen, the Gaze-on-Immortals Tower was built at the Divine Strategy Army.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month on jiashen the Gaze-on-Immortals Tower was built at the Divine Strategy Army.

sentences.zh: 七月丙午朔，日有食之。

translations.literal: Seventh month, first day bingwu, there was an eclipse of the sun.
translations.idiomatic: On the first day of the seventh month, bingwu, there was a solar eclipse.

sentences.zh: 是月，山南東道節度使鄭肅檢校尚書右僕射、同中書門下平章事。

translations.literal: In that month the Shannan East Circuit military commissioner Zheng Su was made acting Right Vice Director and chancellor de facto.
translations.idiomatic: That month Zheng Su of Shannan East was appointed acting Right Vice Director and chancellor de facto.

sentences.zh: 八月壬午，大毀佛寺，復僧尼為民。

translations.literal: Eighth month, day renwu, Buddhist temples were greatly destroyed and monks and nuns restored to commoner status.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month on renwu Buddhist temples were greatly destroyed and monks and nuns returned to commoner status.

sentences.zh: 十月，作昭武廟于虎牢關。

translations.literal: Tenth month: the Manifest Martial Temple was built at Tiger Cage Pass.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month the Manifest Martial Temple was built at Tiger Cage Pass.

sentences.zh: 六年二月癸酉，以旱降死罪以下，免今歲夏稅。

translations.literal: Sixth year, second month, day guiyou, because of drought capital crimes and below were reduced and this year's summer tax was remitted.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth year, second month, on guiyou, owing to drought, capital crimes and below were pardoned and this year's summer tax remitted.

sentences.zh: 庚辰，夏綏銀節度使米暨為東北道招討党項使。

translations.literal: On the day gengchen the Xia-Sui-Yin military commissioner Mi Ji was made northeastern campaign commissioner against the Tangut.
translations.idiomatic: On gengchen Mi Ji of Xia-Sui-Yin was made northeastern Tangut campaign commissioner.

sentences.zh: 三月壬戌，不豫。

translations.literal: Third month, day renxu, he was unwell.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month on renxu he fell ill.

sentences.zh: 左神策軍護軍中尉馬元贄立光王怡為皇太叔，權句當軍國政事。

translations.literal: The Left Divine Strategy Army protective eunuch-commander Ma Yuanzan established Prince of Guang Yi as imperial elder uncle, authorized to handle military and state affairs.
translations.idiomatic: Ma Yuanzan, protective eunuch-commander of the Left Divine Strategy Army, installed Prince of Guang Yi as imperial elder uncle to handle state and military affairs.

sentences.zh: 甲子，皇帝崩于大明宮，年三十三。

translations.literal: On the day jiazi the emperor died at the Great Bright Palace, aged thirty-three.
translations.idiomatic: On jiazi the emperor died in the Great Bright Palace, aged thirty-three.

sentences.zh: 宣宗宣宗元聖至明成武獻文睿智章仁神聰懿道大孝皇帝諱忱，憲宗第十三子也。

translations.literal: __FORCETOC__Emperor Xuanzong, Emperor Xuanzong the Primordial Sagely to the Manifest Bright, Accomplished Martial, Dedicated Literary, Sagely Wise, Manifest Benevolence, Divine Perceptive, Admirable Way, and Greatly Filial, taboo name Chen, was the thirteenth son of Xianzong.
translations.idiomatic: __FORCETOC__Emperor Xuanzong, posthumously honored as the Primordial Sagely to the Manifest Bright, Accomplished Martial, Dedicated Literary, Sagely Wise, Manifest Benevolence, Divine Perceptive, Admirable Way, and Greatly Filial, bore the taboo name Chen and was the thirteenth son of Xianzong.

sentences.zh: 母曰孝明皇太后鄭氏。

translations.literal: His mother was Empress Dowager Xiaoming of the Zheng clan.
translations.idiomatic: His mother was Empress Dowager Xiaoming, née Zheng.

sentences.zh: 始封光王。

translations.literal: He was first enfeoffed as Prince of Guang.
translations.idiomatic: He was first enfeoffed as Prince of Guang.

sentences.zh: 性嚴重寡言，宮中或以為不惠。

translations.literal: His nature was stern and grave and sparing of words; within the palace some regarded him as unintelligent.
translations.idiomatic: By nature he was stern, grave, and sparing of speech; some in the palace thought him dull.

sentences.zh: 會昌六年，武宗疾大漸，左神策軍護軍中尉馬元贄立光王為皇太叔。

translations.literal: In the sixth year of Huichang, Wuzong's illness became grave; the Left Divine Strategy Army protective eunuch-commander Ma Yuanzan established the Prince of Guang as imperial elder uncle.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth year of Huichang Wuzong's illness became grave; Ma Yuanzan, protective eunuch-commander of the Left Divine Strategy Army, installed Prince of Guang as imperial elder uncle.

sentences.zh: 三月甲子，即皇帝位于柩前。

translations.literal: Third month, day jiazi, he ascended the imperial throne before the coffin.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month on jiazi he took the throne before the coffin.

sentences.zh: 四月乙亥，始聽政。

translations.literal: Fourth month, day yihai, he began to hear government affairs.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month on yihai he began to hold court.

sentences.zh: 尊母為皇太后。

translations.literal: His mother was honored as empress dowager.
translations.idiomatic: His mother was honored as empress dowager.

sentences.zh: 丙子，李德裕罷。

translations.literal: On the day bingzi Li Deyu was dismissed.
translations.idiomatic: On bingzi Li Deyu was dismissed.

sentences.zh: 辛卯，李讓夷為司空。

translations.literal: On the day xinmao Li Rangyi was made minister of works.
translations.idiomatic: On xinmao Li Rangyi was appointed minister of works.

sentences.zh: 五月乙巳，大赦。

translations.literal: Fifth month, day yisi, great amnesty.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month on yisi a general amnesty was proclaimed.

sentences.zh: 翰林學士承旨、兵部侍郎白敏中同中書門下平章事。

translations.literal: The Hanlin academician-in-chief and vice minister of war Bai Minzhong was made chancellor de facto.
translations.idiomatic: Bai Minzhong, Hanlin academician-in-chief and vice minister of war, was appointed chancellor de facto.

sentences.zh: 辛酉，封子溫為鄆王，渼雍王，涇雅王，滋夔王，沂慶王。

translations.literal: On the day xinyou his sons Wen was enfeoffed as Prince of Yun, Mei as Prince of Yong, Jing as Prince of Ya, and Zi as Prince of Kui.
translations.idiomatic: On xinyou his sons Wen was enfeoffed as Prince of Yun, Mei as Prince of Yong, Jing as Prince of Ya, and Zi as Prince of Kui.

sentences.zh: 七月，李讓夷罷。

translations.literal: Seventh month: Li Rangyi was dismissed.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month Li Rangyi was dismissed.

sentences.zh: 八月辛未，大行宮火。

translations.literal: Eighth month, day xinwei, the traveling palace burned.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month on xinwei the traveling palace burned.

sentences.zh: 壬申，葬至道昭肅孝皇帝于端陵。

translations.literal: On the day renshen the Utmost Way and Lamenting Filial Emperor was buried at Duan Mausoleum.
translations.idiomatic: On renshen the Utmost Way and Lamenting Filial Emperor was buried at Duan Mausoleum.

sentences.zh: 九月，鄭肅罷。

translations.literal: Ninth month: Zheng Su was dismissed.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month Zheng Su was dismissed.

sentences.zh: 兵部侍郎、判度支盧商為中書侍郎、同中書門下平章事。

translations.literal: The vice minister of war overseeing the budget Lu Shang was made vice director of the Secretariat and chancellor de facto.
translations.idiomatic: Lu Shang, vice minister of war overseeing the budget, was appointed vice director of the Secretariat and chancellor de facto.

sentences.zh: 雲南蠻寇安南，經略使裴元裕敗之。

translations.literal: The Yunnan barbarians raided Annan; the pacification commissioner Pei Yuanyu defeated them.
translations.idiomatic: Yunnan raided Annan; Pei Yuanyu, pacification commissioner, defeated them.

sentences.zh: 十二月戊辰朔，日有食之。

translations.literal: Twelfth month, first day wuchen, there was an eclipse of the sun.
translations.idiomatic: On the first day of the twelfth month, wuchen, there was a solar eclipse.

sentences.zh: 大中元年正月壬子，朝獻于太清宮。

translations.literal: First year of Dazhong, first month, day renzi, he offered tribute at the Grand Pure Palace.
translations.idiomatic: In the first year of Dazhong, first month, on renzi he offered tribute at the Grand Pure Palace.

sentences.zh: 癸丑，朝享于太廟。

translations.literal: On the day guichou he offered sacrifice at the Imperial Ancestral Temple.
translations.idiomatic: On guichou he sacrificed at the Imperial Ancestral Temple.

sentences.zh: 甲寅，有事于南郊。

translations.literal: On the day jiayin he performed the suburban sacrifice.
translations.idiomatic: On jiayin he performed the suburban sacrifice.

sentences.zh: 大赦，改元。

translations.literal: Great amnesty; the reign title was changed.
translations.idiomatic: A general amnesty was proclaimed and the reign title changed.

sentences.zh: 復左降官死者官爵，賜文武官階、勳，父老帛，文宣王後及二王後、三恪予一子官。

translations.literal: Restored ranks and titles of demoted officials who had died; granted civil and military officials ranks and merit titles; granted elders silk; the Duke of Literary Accomplishment's heirs and the two Zhou and Shang lines and three former dynasties each one son an office.
translations.idiomatic: Ranks of deceased demoted officials were restored; ranks and merit titles granted to officials; silk to elders; one son of each among the Duke of Literary Accomplishment's heirs, the Zhou and Shang lines, and the three former dynasties granted an office.

sentences.zh: 二月癸未，以旱避正殿，減膳，理京師囚，罷太常教坊習樂，損百官食，出宮女五百人，放五坊鷹犬，停飛龍馬粟。

translations.literal: Second month, day guimao, because of drought he avoided the main hall, reduced meals, reviewed capital prisoners, halted Instruction Quarter music practice, reduced officials' provisions, released five hundred palace women, released Five Paddock hawks and dogs, and halted Flying Dragon horse grain.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month on guimao, owing to drought, he avoided the main hall, reduced meals, reviewed capital prisoners, halted Instruction Quarter rehearsals, cut officials' provisions, released five hundred palace women and Five Paddock hawks and dogs, and halted Flying Dragon horse grain.

sentences.zh: 三月，盧商罷。

translations.literal: Third month: Lu Shang was dismissed.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month Lu Shang was dismissed.

sentences.zh: 刑部尚書、判度支崔元式為門下侍郎，翰林學士承旨、戶部侍郎韋琮為中書侍郎：同中書門下平章事。

translations.literal: The minister of justice overseeing the budget Cui Yuan Shi was made vice director of the Chancellery, and the Hanlin academician-in-chief and vice minister of revenue Wei Cong was made vice director of the Secretariat: chancellors de facto.
translations.idiomatic: Cui Yuan Shi, minister of justice overseeing the budget, was appointed vice director of the Chancellery, and Wei Cong, Hanlin academician-in-chief and vice minister of revenue, vice director of the Secretariat: both chancellors de facto.

sentences.zh: 閏月，大復佛寺。

translations.literal: Intercalary month: Buddhist temples were greatly restored.
translations.idiomatic: In the intercalary month Buddhist temples were greatly restored.

sentences.zh: 四月己酉，皇太后崩。

translations.literal: Fourth month, day jiyou, the empress dowager died.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month on jiyou the empress dowager died.

sentences.zh: 五月，張仲武及奚北部落戰，敗之。

translations.literal: Fifth month: Zhang Zhongwu fought the northern Xi tribes and defeated them.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month Zhang Zhongwu fought the northern Xi tribes and defeated them.

sentences.zh: 吐蕃、回鶻寇河西，河東節度使王宰伐之。

translations.literal: Tibet and the Uyghurs raided Hexi; the Hedong military commissioner Wang Zai campaigned against them.
translations.idiomatic: Tibet and the Uyghurs raided Hexi; Wang Zai of Hedong campaigned against them.

sentences.zh: 八月丙申，李回罷。

translations.literal: Eighth month, day bingshen, Li Hui was dismissed.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month on bingshen Li Hui was dismissed.

sentences.zh: 庚子，葬貞獻皇太后于光陵。

translations.literal: On the day gengzi Empress Dowager Zhenxian was buried at Guang Mausoleum.
translations.idiomatic: On gengzi Empress Dowager Zhenxian was buried at Guang Mausoleum.

sentences.zh: 十二月戊午，貶太子少保李德裕為潮州司馬。

translations.literal: Twelfth month, day wuwu, the demoted heir-apparent junior guardian Li Deyu was demoted to registrar of Chaozhou.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month on wuwu the demoted heir-apparent junior guardian Li Deyu was demoted to registrar of Chaozhou.

sentences.zh: 二年正月甲子，羣臣上尊號曰聖敬文思和武光孝皇帝。

translations.literal: Second year, first month, day jiazi, the ministers offered the honorific title Sagely Respectful, Civil, Reflective, Harmonious, Martial, and Brightly Filial Emperor.
translations.idiomatic: In the second year, first month, on jiazi the ministers offered the honorific Sagely Respectful, Civil, Reflective, Harmonious, Martial, and Brightly Filial Emperor.

sentences.zh: 大赦。

translations.literal: Great amnesty.
translations.idiomatic: A general amnesty was proclaimed.

sentences.zh: 宗子房未仕者予一人出身，賜文武官階、勳、爵。

translations.literal: Unemployed collateral princes were each granted one son entry into service; civil and military officials were granted ranks, merit titles, and titles.
translations.idiomatic: One son each of unemployed collateral princes received entry into service; ranks, merit titles, and titles were granted to officials.

sentences.zh: 三月，封子澤為濮王。

translations.literal: Third month: his son Ze was enfeoffed as Prince of Pu.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month his son Ze was enfeoffed as Prince of Pu.

sentences.zh: 五月己未朔，日有食之。

translations.literal: Fifth month, first day jiwei, there was an eclipse of the sun.
translations.idiomatic: On the first day of the fifth month, jiwei, there was a solar eclipse.

sentences.zh: 崔元式罷。

translations.literal: Cui Yuan Shi was dismissed.
translations.idiomatic: Cui Yuan Shi was dismissed.

sentences.zh: 兵部侍郎、判度支周墀，刑部侍郎、諸道鹽鐵轉運使馬植：同中書門下平章事。

translations.literal: The vice minister of war overseeing the budget Zhou Chi and the vice minister of justice and salt and iron transport commissioner Ma Zhi: chancellors de facto.
translations.idiomatic: Zhou Chi, vice minister of war overseeing the budget, and Ma Zhi, vice minister of justice and salt and iron transport commissioner, were appointed chancellors de facto.

sentences.zh: 己卯，太皇太后崩。

translations.literal: On the day jimao the grand empress dowager died.
translations.idiomatic: On jimao the grand empress dowager died.

sentences.zh: 七月己巳，續圖功臣于凌煙閣。

translations.literal: Seventh month, day jisi, meritorious ministers were continued on the Lingyan Pavilion.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month on jisi meritorious ministers were added to the Lingyan Pavilion.

sentences.zh: 十一月壬午，葬懿安太皇太后于景陵。

translations.literal: Eleventh month, day renwu, Empress Dowager Yi'an was buried at Jing Mausoleum.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month on renwu Empress Dowager Yi'an was buried at Jing Mausoleum.

sentences.zh: 貶韋琮為太子賓客，分司東都。

translations.literal: Wei Cong was demoted to heir-apparent guest and assigned to the Eastern Capital.
translations.idiomatic: Wei Cong was demoted to heir-apparent guest and assigned to the Eastern Capital.

sentences.zh: 三年二月，吐蕃以秦原安樂三州、石門驛藏木峽制勝六盤石峽蕭七關歸于有司。

translations.literal: Third year, second month: Tibet returned Qin, Yuan, and Anle prefectures and the Shimen, Yicang, Muxia, Zhizhi, Liupan, Shixia, Xiaoqi, and seven other passes to the central authorities.
translations.idiomatic: In the third year, second month, Tibet returned Qin, Yuan, and Anle prefectures and the Shimen, Yicang, Muxia, Zhizhi, Liupan, Shixia, Xiaoqi, and seven other passes to the central government.

sentences.zh: 三月，詔待制官與刑法官、諫官次對。

translations.literal: Third month: an edict ordered awaiting-appointment officials to answer in turn with judicial and remonstrance officials.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month an edict ordered awaiting-appointment officials to answer in turn with judicial and remonstrance officials.

sentences.zh: 馬植罷。

translations.literal: Ma Zhi was dismissed.
translations.idiomatic: Ma Zhi was dismissed.

sentences.zh: 是春，隕霜殺桑。

translations.literal: That spring frost killed mulberry trees.
translations.idiomatic: That spring frost killed the mulberry trees.

sentences.zh: 四月乙酉，周墀罷。

translations.literal: Fourth month, day yiyou, Zhou Chi was dismissed.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month on yiyou Zhou Chi was dismissed.

sentences.zh: 御史大夫崔鉉為中書侍郎，兵部侍郎、判戶部事魏扶：同中書門下平章事。

translations.literal: The censor-in-chief Cui Xuan was made vice director of the Secretariat, and the vice minister of war overseeing revenue Wei Fu: chancellors de facto.
translations.idiomatic: Cui Xuan, censor-in-chief, was appointed vice director of the Secretariat, and Wei Fu, vice minister of war overseeing revenue, chancellor de facto.

sentences.zh: 癸巳，幽州盧龍軍節度使張仲武卒，其子直方自稱留後。

translations.literal: On the day guisi the Youzhou Lulong military commissioner Zhang Zhongwu died; his son Zhifang styled himself acting commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: On guisi Zhang Zhongwu of Youzhou Lulong died; his son Zhifang declared himself acting commissioner.

sentences.zh: 五月，武寧軍亂，逐其節度使李廓。

translations.literal: Fifth month: the Wuning army mutinied and expelled its military commissioner Li Kuo.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month the Wuning garrison mutinied and expelled Commissioner Li Kuo.

sentences.zh: 十月辛巳，京師地震。

translations.literal: Tenth month, day xinsi, the capital earthquake.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month on xinsi the capital was shaken by an earthquake.

sentences.zh: 是月，振武及天德、靈武、鹽夏二州地震。

translations.literal: In that month Zhenwu and Tiande, Lingwu, and Yan and Xia prefectures earthquake.
translations.idiomatic: That month Zhenwu, Tiande, Lingwu, and Yan and Xia prefectures were shaken by earthquakes.

sentences.zh: 吐蕃以維州歸于有司。

translations.literal: Tibet returned Wei prefecture to the central authorities.
translations.idiomatic: Tibet returned Wei prefecture to the central government.

sentences.zh: 十一月己卯，封弟惕為彭王。

translations.literal: Eleventh month, day jimao, his younger brother Ti was enfeoffed as Prince of Peng.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month on jimao his younger brother Ti was enfeoffed as Prince of Peng.

sentences.zh: 十二月，吐蕃以扶州歸于有司。

translations.literal: Twelfth month: Tibet returned Fu prefecture to the central authorities.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month Tibet returned Fu prefecture to the central government.

sentences.zh: 四年正月庚辰，大赦。

translations.literal: Fourth year, first month, day gengchen, great amnesty.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth year, first month, on gengchen a general amnesty was proclaimed.

sentences.zh: 四月壬申，以雨霖，詔京師、關輔理囚，蠲度支、鹽鐵、戶部逋負。

translations.literal: Fourth month, day renshen, because of prolonged rain an edict ordered review of prisoners in the capital and Guanfu circuits and remission of arrears in the budget, salt and iron, and revenue bureaus.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month on renshen, owing to prolonged rain, an edict ordered prisoner review in the capital and Guanfu and remission of budget, salt and iron, and revenue arrears.

sentences.zh: 六月戊申，魏扶薨。

translations.literal: Sixth month, day wushen, Wei Fu died.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month on wushen Wei Fu died.

sentences.zh: 戶部尚書、判度支崔龜從同中書門下平章事。

translations.literal: The minister of revenue overseeing the budget Cui Guicong was made chancellor de facto.
translations.idiomatic: Cui Guicong, minister of revenue overseeing the budget, was appointed chancellor de facto.

sentences.zh: 八月，幽州盧龍軍亂，逐其節度使張直方，衙將張允伸自稱留後。

translations.literal: Eighth month: the Youzhou Lulong army mutinied, expelled its military commissioner Zhang Zhifang; the yamen officer Zhang Yunshen styled himself acting commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month the Youzhou Lulong garrison mutinied, expelled Commissioner Zhang Zhifang, and Zhang Yunshen, yamen officer, declared himself acting commissioner.

sentences.zh: 十月辛未，翰林學士承旨、兵部侍郎令狐綯同中書門下平章事。

translations.literal: Tenth month, day xinwei, the Hanlin academician-in-chief and vice minister of war Linghu Tao was made chancellor de facto.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month on xinwei Linghu Tao, Hanlin academician-in-chief and vice minister of war, was appointed chancellor de facto.

sentences.zh: 十一月，党項羌寇邠、寧。

translations.literal: Eleventh month: the Tangut raided Bin and Ning.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month the Tangut raided Bin and Ning.

sentences.zh: 十二月，鳳翔節度使李安業、河東節度使李拭為招討党項使。

translations.literal: Twelfth month: the Fengxiang military commissioner Li Anye and the Hedong military commissioner Li Shi were made campaign commissioners against the Tangut.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month Li Anye of Fengxiang and Li Shi of Hedong were made Tangut campaign commissioners.

sentences.zh: 五年三月，白敏中為司空，招討南山、平夏党項行營兵馬都統。

translations.literal: Fifth year, third month: Bai Minzhong was made minister of works and overall commander of the southern mountain and Pingxia Tangut campaign horse-and-army.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth year, third month, Bai Minzhong was made minister of works and overall commander of the southern mountain and Pingxia Tangut campaign.

sentences.zh: 四月，赦平夏党項羌。

translations.literal: Fourth month: the Pingxia Tangut were pardoned.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month the Pingxia Tangut were pardoned.

sentences.zh: 辛未，給復靈鹽夏三州、邠寧鄜坊等道三歲。

translations.literal: On the day xinwei Ling, Yan, and Xia prefectures and Binning, Zhengyuan, and other circuits were granted tax remission for three years.
translations.idiomatic: On xinwei Ling, Yan, and Xia and Binning, Zhengyuan, and other circuits received three years' tax remission.

sentences.zh: 六月，封子潤為鄂王。

translations.literal: Sixth month: his son Run was enfeoffed as Prince of E.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month his son Run was enfeoffed as Prince of E.

sentences.zh: 八月乙巳，赦南山党項羌。

translations.literal: Eighth month, day yisi, the southern mountain Tangut were pardoned.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month on yisi the southern mountain Tangut were pardoned.

sentences.zh: 十月，沙州人張義潮以瓜、沙、伊、肅、鄯、甘、河、西、蘭、岷、廓十一州歸于有司。

translations.literal: Tenth month: Zhang Yichao of Shazhou submitted eleven prefectures—Gua, Sha, Yi, Su, Shan, Gan, He, Xi, Lan, Min, and Kuo—to the central authorities.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month Zhang Yichao of Shazhou submitted Gua, Sha, Yi, Su, Shan, Gan, He, Xi, Lan, Min, and Kuo—eleven prefectures—to the central government.

sentences.zh: 白敏中罷。

translations.literal: Bai Minzhong was dismissed.
translations.idiomatic: Bai Minzhong was dismissed.

sentences.zh: 戊辰，戶部侍郎、判戶部魏謩同中書門下平章事。

translations.literal: On the day wuchen the vice minister of revenue overseeing revenue Wei Mo was made chancellor de facto.
translations.idiomatic: On wuchen Wei Mo, vice minister of revenue overseeing revenue, was appointed chancellor de facto.

sentences.zh: 十一月，崔龜從罷。

translations.literal: Eleventh month: Cui Guicong was dismissed.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month Cui Guicong was dismissed.

sentences.zh: 十二月，盜斫景陵門戟。

translations.literal: Twelfth month: robbers cut down the Jing Mausoleum gate halberds.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month robbers cut down the Jing Mausoleum gate halberds.

sentences.zh: 是歲，湖南饑。

translations.literal: That year Hunan suffered famine.
translations.idiomatic: That year Hunan suffered famine.

sentences.zh: 六年三月，有彗星出于觜、參。

translations.literal: Sixth year, third month: a comet appeared in Turtle Beak and Three Stars.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth year, third month, a comet appeared in Turtle Beak and Three Stars.

sentences.zh: 七月，雍王渼薨。

translations.literal: Seventh month: Prince of Yong Mei died.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month Prince of Yong Mei died.

sentences.zh: 八月，禮部尚書、諸道鹽鐵轉運使裴休同中書門下平章事。

translations.literal: Eighth month: the minister of rites and salt and iron transport commissioner Pei Xiu was made chancellor de facto.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month Pei Xiu, minister of rites and salt and iron transport commissioner, was appointed chancellor de facto.

sentences.zh: 九月，獠寇昌、資二州。

translations.literal: Ninth month: the Liao raided Chang and Zi prefectures.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month the Liao raided Chang and Zi prefectures.

sentences.zh: 十一月，封弟惴為棣王。

translations.literal: Eleventh month: his younger brother Zhui was enfeoffed as Prince of Di.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month his younger brother Zhui was enfeoffed as Prince of Di.

sentences.zh: 是歲，淮南饑。

translations.literal: That year Huainan suffered famine.
translations.idiomatic: That year Huainan suffered famine.

sentences.zh: 七年正月丙午，朝獻于太清宮。

translations.literal: Seventh year, first month, day bingwu, he offered tribute at the Grand Pure Palace.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh year, first month, on bingwu he offered tribute at the Grand Pure Palace.

sentences.zh: 丁未，朝享于太廟。

translations.literal: On the day dingwei he offered sacrifice at the Imperial Ancestral Temple.
translations.idiomatic: On dingwei he sacrificed at the Imperial Ancestral Temple.

sentences.zh: 戊申，有事于南郊，大赦。

translations.literal: On the day wushen he performed the suburban sacrifice; great amnesty.
translations.idiomatic: On wushen he performed the suburban sacrifice and proclaimed a general amnesty.

sentences.zh: 八年正月丙戌朔，日有食之。

translations.literal: Eighth year, first month, first day bingxu, there was an eclipse of the sun.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth year, first month, on the first day bingxu, there was a solar eclipse.

sentences.zh: 三月，以旱理囚。

translations.literal: Third month: because of drought prisoners were reviewed.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month prisoners were reviewed because of drought.

sentences.zh: 九月，封子洽為懷王，汭昭王，汶康王。

translations.literal: Ninth month: his sons Qia was enfeoffed as Prince of Huai, Rui as Prince of Zhao, and Wen as Prince of Kang.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month his sons Qia was enfeoffed as Prince of Huai, Rui as Prince of Zhao, and Wen as Prince of Kang.

sentences.zh: 九年正月甲申，成德軍節度使王元逵卒，其子紹鼎自稱留後。

translations.literal: Ninth year, first month, day jiashen, the Chengde military commissioner Wang Yuankui died; his son Shaoding styled himself acting commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth year, first month, on jiashen Wang Yuankui of Chengde died; his son Shaoding declared himself acting commissioner.

sentences.zh: 閏四月辛丑，禁嶺外民鬻男女者。

translations.literal: Intercalary fourth month, day xinchou, selling men and women south of the ranges was forbidden.
translations.idiomatic: In the intercalary fourth month on xinchou selling men and women south of the ranges was forbidden.

sentences.zh: 七月，以旱遣使巡撫淮南，減上供饋運，蠲逋租，發粟賑民。

translations.literal: Seventh month: because of drought envoys were sent to comfort Huainan; upper tribute and transport were reduced; overdue rents remitted; grain distributed to relieve the people.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month, owing to drought, envoys were sent to comfort Huainan; upper tribute and transport were reduced; overdue rents remitted; and grain distributed to the people.

sentences.zh: 丙辰，崔鉉罷。

translations.literal: On the day bingchen Cui Xuan was dismissed.
translations.idiomatic: On bingchen Cui Xuan was dismissed.

sentences.zh: 庚申，罷淮南宣歙浙西冬至、元日常貢，以代下戶租稅。

translations.literal: On the day gengshen winter solstice and New Year's regular tribute from Huainan, Xuanshe, and western Zhejiang was halted to replace lower-household rent and tax.
translations.idiomatic: On gengshen winter solstice and New Year's regular tribute from Huainan, Xuanshe, and western Zhejiang was halted in place of lower-household rent and tax.

sentences.zh: 是月，浙江東道軍亂，逐其觀察使李訥。

translations.literal: In that month the Zhejiang East Circuit army mutinied and expelled its observation commissioner Li Na.
translations.idiomatic: That month the Zhejiang East garrison mutinied and expelled Observation Commissioner Li Na.

sentences.zh: 十年正月丁巳，御史大夫鄭朗為工部尚書、同中書門下平章事。

translations.literal: Tenth year, first month, day dingsi, the censor-in-chief Zheng Lang was made minister of works and chancellor de facto.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth year, first month, on dingsi Zheng Lang, censor-in-chief, was appointed minister of works and chancellor de facto.

sentences.zh: 九月，封子灌為衞王。

translations.literal: Ninth month: his son Guan was enfeoffed as Prince of Wei.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month his son Guan was enfeoffed as Prince of Wei.

sentences.zh: 十月戊子，裴休罷。

translations.literal: Tenth month, day wuzi, Pei Xiu was dismissed.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month on wuzi Pei Xiu was dismissed.

sentences.zh: 十二月壬辰，戶部侍郎、判戶部崔慎由為工部尚書、同中書門下平章事。

translations.literal: Twelfth month, day renchen, the vice minister of revenue overseeing revenue Cui Shenyou was made minister of works and chancellor de facto.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month on renchen Cui Shenyou, vice minister of revenue overseeing revenue, was appointed minister of works and chancellor de facto.

sentences.zh: 十一年二月辛巳，魏謩罷。

translations.literal: Eleventh year, second month, day xinsi, Wei Mo was dismissed.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh year, second month, on xinsi Wei Mo was dismissed.

sentences.zh: 五月，容管軍亂，逐其經略使王球。

translations.literal: Fifth month: the Rongguan army mutinied and expelled its pacification commissioner Wang Qiu.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month the Rongguan garrison mutinied and expelled Pacification Commissioner Wang Qiu.

sentences.zh: 七月庚子，兵部侍郎、判度支蕭鄴同中書門下平章事。

translations.literal: Seventh month, day gengzi, the vice minister of war overseeing the budget Xiao Ye was made chancellor de facto.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month on gengzi Xiao Ye, vice minister of war overseeing the budget, was appointed chancellor de facto.

sentences.zh: 成德軍節度副大使王紹鼎卒，其弟紹懿自稱留後。

translations.literal: The Chengde deputy military commissioner Wang Shaoding died; his younger brother Shaooyi styled himself acting commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: Wang Shaoding, Chengde deputy commissioner, died; his younger brother Shaooyi declared himself acting commissioner.

sentences.zh: 八月，封子澭為廣王。

translations.literal: Eighth month: his son Huang was enfeoffed as Prince of Guang.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month his son Huang was enfeoffed as Prince of Guang.

sentences.zh: 九月乙未，有彗星出于房。

translations.literal: Ninth month, day yiwei, a comet appeared in Room.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month on yiwei a comet appeared in the Room asterism.

sentences.zh: 十月壬申，鄭朗罷。

translations.literal: Tenth month, day renshen, Zheng Lang was dismissed.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month on renshen Zheng Lang was dismissed.

sentences.zh: 十二年正月戊戌，戶部侍郎、判度支劉瑑同中書門下平章事。

translations.literal: Twelfth year, first month, day wuxu, the vice minister of revenue overseeing the budget Liu Zhan was made chancellor de facto.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth year, first month, on wuxu Liu Zhan, vice minister of revenue overseeing the budget, was appointed chancellor de facto.

sentences.zh: 二月，廢穆宗忌日，停光陵朝拜及守陵宮人。

translations.literal: Second month: Muzong's death-day observance was abolished; Guang Mausoleum visits and tomb-guarding palace women were halted.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month Muzong's death-day observance was abolished and Guang Mausoleum visits and tomb-guarding palace women were halted.

sentences.zh: 壬申，崔慎由罷。

translations.literal: On the day renshen Cui Shenyou was dismissed.
translations.idiomatic: On renshen Cui Shenyou was dismissed.

sentences.zh: 閏月，自十月不雨，至于是月雨。

translations.literal: Intercalary month: from the tenth month there was no rain until this month it rained.
translations.idiomatic: In the intercalary month, after no rain since the tenth month, rain finally fell.

sentences.zh: 三月，鹽州監軍使楊玄价殺其刺史劉皐。

translations.literal: Third month: the Yanzhou army supervisory commissioner Yang Xuanjia executed its prefect Liu Gao.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month Yang Xuanjia, Yanzhou army supervisory commissioner, executed Prefect Liu Gao.

sentences.zh: 四月庚子，嶺南軍亂，逐其節度使楊發。

translations.literal: Fourth month, day gengzi, the Lingnan army mutinied and expelled its military commissioner Yang Fa.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month on gengzi the Lingnan garrison mutinied and expelled Commissioner Yang Fa.

sentences.zh: 戊申，兵部侍郎、諸道鹽鐵轉運使夏侯孜同中書門下平章事。

translations.literal: On the day wushen the vice minister of war and salt and iron transport commissioner Xiahou Zi was made chancellor de facto.
translations.idiomatic: On wushen Xiahou Zi, vice minister of war and salt and iron transport commissioner, was appointed chancellor de facto.

sentences.zh: 五月丙寅，劉瑑薨。

translations.literal: Fifth month, day bingyin, Liu Zhan died.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month on bingyin Liu Zhan died.

sentences.zh: 庚辰，湖南軍亂，逐其觀察使韓琮。

translations.literal: On the day gengchen the Hunan army mutinied and expelled its observation commissioner Han Cong.
translations.idiomatic: On gengchen the Hunan garrison mutinied and expelled Observation Commissioner Han Cong.

sentences.zh: 六月丙申，江西都將毛鶴逐其觀察使鄭憲。

translations.literal: Sixth month, day bingshen, the Jiangxi overall officer Mao He expelled its observation commissioner Zheng Xian.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month on bingshen Mao He, Jiangxi overall officer, expelled Observation Commissioner Zheng Xian.

sentences.zh: 辛亥，南蠻寇邊。

translations.literal: On the day xinhai the southern barbarians raided the frontier.
translations.idiomatic: On xinhai the southern tribes raided the frontier.

sentences.zh: 七月，容州將來正反，伏誅。

translations.literal: Seventh month: the Rong prefecture officer Lai Zhengfan rebelled and was executed.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month Lai Zhengfan, an officer of Rong prefecture, rebelled and was executed.

sentences.zh: 八月，宣歙將康全泰逐其觀察使鄭薰，淮南節度使崔鉉兼宣歙池觀察處置使以討之。

translations.literal: Eighth month: the Xuanshe officer Kang Quantai expelled its observation commissioner Zheng Xun; the Huainan military commissioner Cui Xuan was also made Xuanshe-Chi observation and disposition commissioner to campaign against him.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month Kang Quantai of Xuanshe expelled Observation Commissioner Zheng Xun; Cui Xuan of Huainan was also made Xuanshe-Chi observation commissioner to campaign against him.

sentences.zh: 丁巳，太原地震。

translations.literal: On the day dingsi Taiyuan earthquake.
translations.idiomatic: On dingsi Taiyuan was shaken by an earthquake.

sentences.zh: 十月，康全泰伏誅。

translations.literal: Tenth month: Kang Quantai was executed.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month Kang Quantai was executed.

sentences.zh: 十二月，毛鶴伏誅。

translations.literal: Twelfth month: Mao He was executed.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month Mao He was executed.

sentences.zh: 甲寅，兵部侍郎、判戶部蔣伸同中書門下平章事。

translations.literal: On the day jiayin the vice minister of war overseeing revenue Jiang Shen was made chancellor de facto.
translations.idiomatic: On jiayin Jiang Shen, vice minister of war overseeing revenue, was appointed chancellor de facto.

sentences.zh: 十三年正月戊午，大赦，蠲度支、戶部逋負，放宮人。

translations.literal: Thirteenth year, first month, day wuwu, great amnesty; budget and revenue arrears were remitted; palace women were released.
translations.idiomatic: In the thirteenth year, first month, on wuwu a general amnesty was proclaimed; budget and revenue arrears remitted; and palace women released.

sentences.zh: 八月壬辰，左神策軍護軍中尉王宗實立鄆王溫為皇太子，權句當軍國政事。

translations.literal: Eighth month, day renchen, the Left Divine Strategy Army protective eunuch-commander Wang Zongshi established Prince of Yun Wen as heir apparent, authorized to handle military and state affairs.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month on renchen Wang Zongshi, protective eunuch-commander of the Left Divine Strategy Army, installed Prince of Yun Wen as heir apparent to handle state and military affairs.

sentences.zh: 癸巳，皇帝崩于咸寧殿，年五十。

translations.literal: On the day guisi the emperor died at the Hall of Universal Tranquility, aged fifty.
translations.idiomatic: On guisi the emperor died in the Hall of Universal Tranquility, aged fifty.

sentences.zh: 謚曰聖武獻文孝皇帝。

translations.literal: His posthumous title was Sagely Martial and Dedicated Literary Filial Emperor.
translations.idiomatic: His posthumous title was Sagely Martial and Dedicated Literary Filial Emperor.

sentences.zh: 咸通十三年，加謚元聖至明成武獻文睿智章仁神聰懿道大孝皇帝。

translations.literal: In the thirteenth year of Xiantong the posthumous title was augmented to Primordial Sagely to the Manifest Bright, Accomplished Martial, Dedicated Literary, Sagely Wise, Manifest Benevolence, Divine Perceptive, Admirable Way, and Greatly Filial Emperor.
translations.idiomatic: In the thirteenth year of Xiantong his posthumous title was augmented to Primordial Sagely to the Manifest Bright, Accomplished Martial, Dedicated Literary, Sagely Wise, Manifest Benevolence, Divine Perceptive, Admirable Way, and Greatly Filial Emperor.

sentences.zh: 【贊】贊曰：春秋之法，君弒而賊不討，則深責其國，以為無臣子也。

translations.literal: 【Praise】Praise says: The method of the Spring and Autumn Annals is that when a ruler is assassinated and the assassin is not punished, the state is deeply blamed—as having no ministers and sons.
translations.idiomatic: 【Praise】The Annals' method is this: when a ruler is murdered and the murderer goes unpunished, the state itself is held deeply at fault—as a realm without loyal ministers and sons.

sentences.zh: 憲宗之弒，歷三世而賊猶在。

translations.literal: Xianzong's assassination passed through three reigns and the assassin was still alive.
translations.idiomatic: Xianzong's murderers survived through three reigns unpunished.

sentences.zh: 至於文宗，不能明弘志等罪惡，以正國之典刑，僅能殺之而已，是可歎也。

translations.literal: As for Wenzong, he could not clarify Hongzhi and the others' crimes to rectify the state's penal code; he could only kill them—that is lamentable.
translations.idiomatic: As for Wenzong, he could not clarify Hongzhi and the others' crimes to set the state's penal standard right; he could only kill them—which is lamentable.

sentences.zh: 穆、敬昏童失德，以其在位不久，故天下未至於敗亂，而敬宗卒及其身，是豈有討賊之志哉！

translations.literal: Muzong and Jingzong were foolish youths who lost virtue; because their reigns were brief the realm did not yet fall into disorder, yet Jingzong in the end died by the assassin's hand—how could he have had the will to punish the murderers!
translations.idiomatic: Muzong and Jingzong were foolish youths who lost virtue; because their reigns were brief the realm had not yet collapsed into disorder, yet Jingzong in the end died by assassination—what will to punish the murderers could he have had!

sentences.zh: 文宗恭儉儒雅，出於天性，嘗讀太宗政要，慨然慕之。

translations.literal: Wenzong was respectful, frugal, and refined in learning by nature; he once read Taizong's Essentials of Government and sighed with admiration.
translations.idiomatic: Wenzong was by nature respectful, frugal, and refined in learning; he once read Taizong's Essentials of Government and sighed with admiration.

sentences.zh: 及即位，銳意於治，每延英對宰臣，率漏下十一刻。

translations.literal: When he took the throne he was keen on governance; whenever he met chancellors at Yanying he usually continued until the eleventh watch.
translations.idiomatic: When he took the throne he was keen on governance; at Yanying audiences with chancellors he usually continued until the eleventh watch.

sentences.zh: 唐制，天子以隻日視朝，乃命輟朝、放朝皆用雙日。

translations.literal: Tang custom had the Son of Heaven hold court on odd days; he ordered that canceled and released court days should all use even days.
translations.idiomatic: By Tang custom the Son of Heaven held court on odd days; he ordered that canceled and released court days should all fall on even days.

sentences.zh: 凡除吏必召見訪問，親察其能否。

translations.literal: Whenever he appointed officials he would summon and question them, personally observing their ability.
translations.idiomatic: Whenever he appointed officials he summoned and questioned them, personally testing their ability.

sentences.zh: 故大和之初，政事脩飭，號為清明。

translations.literal: Therefore at the beginning of Dahe government was put in order and called clear and bright.
translations.idiomatic: Therefore at the beginning of Dahe government was put in order and the age was called clear and bright.

sentences.zh: 然其仁而少斷，承父兄之弊，宦官橈權，制之不得其術，故其終困以此。

translations.literal: Yet he was benevolent but little decisive; inheriting his father and elder brother's abuses, eunuchs bent power, and because he could not control them by the right method he was in the end trapped thereby.
translations.idiomatic: Yet he was benevolent but indecisive; inheriting his father and elder brother's abuses, eunuchs bent power, and because he could not master them by the right method he was trapped in the end.

sentences.zh: 甘露之事，禍及忠良，不勝冤憤，飲恨而已。

translations.literal: The Sweet Dew affair brought disaster on the loyal and good; unable to overcome wrongful indignation, they drank resentment to the dregs.
translations.idiomatic: The Sweet Dew affair brought disaster on the loyal; unable to overcome wrongful indignation, the worthy drank resentment to the dregs.

sentences.zh: 由是言之，其能殺弘志，亦足伸其志也。

translations.literal: From this perspective, that he could kill Hongzhi was also enough to fulfill his purpose.
translations.idiomatic: From this perspective, that he could kill Hongzhi was enough to fulfill his purpose.

sentences.zh: 昔武丁得一傅說，為商高宗。

translations.literal: In antiquity Wuding obtained one Fu Yue and made the Shang high ancestor.
translations.idiomatic: In antiquity Wuding obtained one Fu Yue and made the Shang high ancestor.

sentences.zh: 武宗用一李德裕，遂成其功烈。

translations.literal: Wuzong employed one Li Deyu and thereby accomplished his great achievements.
translations.idiomatic: Wuzong employed one Li Deyu and thereby accomplished his great achievements.

sentences.zh: 然其奮然除去浮圖之法甚銳，而躬受道家之籙，服藥以求長年。

translations.literal: Yet he energetically abolished the Buddhist law very sharply while personally receiving Daoist registers and taking medicine to seek long life.
translations.idiomatic: Yet he energetically abolished the Buddhist law while personally receiving Daoist registers and taking medicine to seek long life.

sentences.zh: 以此見其非明智之不惑者，特好惡有不同爾。

translations.literal: From this one sees he was not a wise man free from delusion; only his likes and dislikes differed.
translations.idiomatic: From this one sees he was not a wise man wholly free from delusion; only his likes and dislikes differed.

sentences.zh: 宣宗精於聽斷，而以察為明，無復仁恩之意。

translations.literal: Xuanzong was skilled in hearing and deciding but took scrutiny as clarity and had no further benevolent grace.
translations.idiomatic: Xuanzong was skilled in hearing and deciding but took scrutiny for clarity and showed no further benevolent grace.

sentences.zh: 嗚呼，自是而後，唐衰矣！

translations.literal: Alas, from this time onward Tang declined!
translations.idiomatic: Alas, from this time onward Tang declined!
